Integrate third-party APIs and AI services, including LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic and OpenRouter, as well as marketing data sources.

• 
Write clean, maintainable Python code and contribute to a well-structured, evolving codebase.

• 
Work independently in a remote environment, manage your own workload, and communicate clearly with a small, senior team.

• 
Bring your own ideas and experience to help shape how we build and improve the product.

What you bring

• 
5 years of hands-on experience as a full-stack developer, preferably with Django as your primary framework.

Solid Python skills and a track record of building and shipping real products.

Experience building AI-powered products using LangChain, LangSmith, OpenAI, OpenRouter or Anthropic APIs.

Familiarity with Docker and confident Git workflow management.

• 
A working style that combines pre-AI fundamentals with modern AI-assisted development. We use tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code, and we want to understand how you work with them.

Strong written and spoken English.

Nice to have

Experience with GCP, Azure or CI/CD and DevOps pipelines.

• 
Front-end and UI design sensibility. AI handles a lot of this, but a strong eye for design genuinely elevates the product.

• 
German language skills would be an advantage.

What you can expect

• 
flexible, remote freelance engagement of around 60 hours per month.

• 
A small, senior team with short decision-making paths and real ownership over what you build.

• 
Work on a live, evolving AI product with a clear roadmap and genuine ambition.

• 
The freedom to bring your own experience and ideas to the table.

How to apply

• 
A short video is a required part of our application process.

• 
Please submit your CV together with a two-minute video recorded using Loom, your phone or any other tool, and include the link in your application.

In the video, tell us a little about yourself, why you are interested in this role, and how you currently work with AI tools day to day.

We are only able to consider applications that include both a CV and a video.
English is our working language. German is a plus and we welcome applicants who speak both.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer - Planning, Decision & Intercept
jobs.description:
Building autonomous supremacy systems in Berlin

Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. We design tightly integrated autonomy stacks in Europe to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces, focusing on defensive and counter-system capabilities including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions.

We are looking for a Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer to build the intelligence that turns mission objectives, target information and vehicle state into executable autonomous behaviour.

Your mission with us

• 
Build the autonomy layer of our high-speed aerial robotic systems.

• 
Convert mission objectives, target state and vehicle state into real-time actions and trajectories.

• 
Develop algorithms for dynamic rendezvous, pursuit, interception and terminal approach.

• 
Build target-motion prediction and intercept-point estimation for moving airborne targets.

• 
Develop real-time path planning, trajectory generation and replanning under uncertainty.

• 
Account for aircraft capabilities, energy, maneuverability, sensing uncertainty and changing target behaviour.

• 
Build decision and behaviour logic that allows the system to adapt continuously during a mission.

• 
Combine classical robotics, optimization, MPC and learned approaches where appropriate.

• 
Explore reinforcement learning, imitation learning and policy-based autonomy where they provide meaningful advantages.

• 
Work closely with perception, estimation and control engineers to close the autonomy loop.

• 
Take algorithms from simulation into real aircraft and validate them through repeated flight testing.

Your contribution to the team (required)

• 
Strong robotics or autonomous-systems background with significant real-world deployment experience.

• 
Strong experience with motion planning, trajectory generation or autonomous decision-making.

• 
Deep understanding of kinematics, dynamics and optimization.

• 
Experience with dynamic environments and moving-target problems.

• 
Experience with trajectory optimization, optimal control, MPC or comparable approaches.

• 
Strong C++ skills and good Python skills.

• 
Experience deploying autonomy algorithms onto real robotic systems.

• 
Strong understanding of uncertainty and its implications for decision-making and planning.

• 
Ability to design algorithms that operate under real-time compute constraints.

• 
Hands-on attitude and willingness to participate directly in flight testing and system debugging.

Big plus

• 
UAV / fixed-wing autonomy.

• 
High-speed aerial robotics.

• 
Rendezvous, pursuit or intercept problems.

• 
Target-motion prediction.

• 
Aggressive flight.

• 
Reinforcement learning on real robots.

• 
Imitation learning / learned policies.

• 
PX4.

• 
ROS2.

• 
Optimal control and trajectory optimization.

• 
Aviation, defence or space systems.

Even if you don’t tick every box, we encourage you to apply - we’d love to hear from you.

01 · Why this role exists

Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Europe can reindustrialise if we bring AI, energy market opportunities and industrial processes together. Europe's largest industrial companies, together around 2% of Europe's total energy demand, already make their energy decisions with RIZMO, the AI agent in our Energy OS at RIZM.

As Product Engineer you build that product. You decide what we build and ship it to real industrial sites, with short feedback loops straight from the customer. No ticket queue. You'll work from our office in Munich or Münster.

02 · Meet Max, your Head of Engineering

I'm Max, Head of Engineering at RIZM. My team and I own our product: intuitive workflows, outstanding algorithms, resilient infrastructure and an AI agent layer on top of it all.

What drives me is the speed here: fast decisions, quick iterations and real responsibility for everyone. What matters most to us is high ownership, a growth mindset, trust and having each other's back, in a team where everyone can grow, thrive and have fun together along the way.

If you want to change how Europe's industry uses energy, we'd be thrilled to have you on board.

Let's make the energy transition real, together.
Max

03 · What you'll be building

• Features end to end: Take user-facing features in Digital Twin, Designer, Operator and Portfolio Manager from idea through design to production.

• AI agents that act: Build agents that read digital twins, run optimisations, explain plans and soon act on their own. Make them reliable with guardrails, grounding and evals tested against real customer data.

• Data people understand: Turn complex simulations and live data streams from customers' IT/OT systems, markets and weather into clear charts, time series and maps.

04 · What you bring

• Experience: 2–5 years building customer-facing products, with a proven track record of taking complex features from idea to launch.

• Tech skills: Strong TypeScript with Vue or React, comfortable across browser, Node and PostgreSQL, plus containers and CI/CD.

• AI-native: You have shipped LLM features to real users and know their costs and failure modes. Claude Code, agents and subagents are part of your daily work.

• Ownership: You care about design details, cut scope without being asked and enjoy unclear problems. You don't need to know industrial energy yet, just be curious about it.

Our stack: Vue, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud (Kubernetes, GitLab CI), LangGraph across multiple models, Julia and Python for optimisation and forecasting. You don't need to know Julia, just don't be scared of it.

05 · Why you should apply now

Europe's energy market is going through its biggest change in decades. RIZM grew from a Stanford research project into a fast-growing company whose software runs at sites like BMW and BSH. Demand is outpacing our team and our next funding round is ahead. Join now and shape what comes next.

06 · One click, then what?

For now it's just one small step: press Apply. Here is a sneak peek at what comes next.

Your application: Send us your CV and, instead of a classic cover letter, a few honest lines on these two questions. No templates, no buzzwords.

• One weekend, Claude Code, unlimited tokens. What do you build, and why that?

• RIZMO is our AI agent that runs energy decisions for industrial sites. Which new skill would you give it tomorrow, and what is the biggest bottleneck to building it?

After that:

• Technical challenge: A hands-on task that shows how you think and build.

• Technical deep dive: With Max and the engineering team, where we go through your challenge together.

About Promethion Industries

Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. Our mission is to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces through tightly integrated autonomy stacks designed and built in Europe. Our focus is defensive and counter-system capabilities, including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions. 

We are looking for a Senior Robotics Engineer - State Estimation, VIO & Sensor Fusion to build the estimation backbone that allows our aircraft to understand their own motion without depending on GNSS.

Your mission with us

• 
Build the state-estimation and sensor-fusion backbone of our autonomous aerial systems.

• 
Develop robust vehicle-state estimation for high-dynamic flight and GNSS-degraded or GNSS-denied environments.

Fuse IMUs, cameras, optical flow, airspeed, GNSS, barometers and other sensors into reliable low-latency estimates.

• 
Develop, integrate and deploy VIO, visual odometry, ego-motion optical flow and inertial-estimation approaches.

Own temporal calibration, sensor synchronisation, coordinate frames and estimator consistency.

Diagnose drift, bias, observability and timing problems from first principles.

Work directly with real flight logs and hardware to reproduce estimator failures and rapidly improve performance.

Build graceful degradation when individual sensors become unreliable or unavailable.

At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We are hiring a backend-leaning Tech Lead to lead a team of 3-4 engineers and own the tech for a part of Superchat’s product.

This is a hands-on leadership role: You’ll spend roughly half your time designing and building software and the other half enabling your team to perform at its best. Work directly on architecture, development and important projects while creating the clarity, feedback and environment your engineers need to deliver an excellent product

Who We Want

A strong, current backend engineer.
You bring 3+ years of experience as a Senior or Staff Engineer and remain deeply involved in software development. You are comfortable owning, designing and building crucial parts of production systems.

Experienced with the JVM ecosystem.
You have substantial experience with Java or another JVM language. Kotlin and AWS experience are a plus, since our backend runs on Kotlin/Quarkus.

Ready to lead people.
You may already have worked in a hybrid Tech Lead role, have been an Engineering manager for a short time or be taking your first steps in people leadership after successfully owning projects and architecture. What matters is that you genuiely want to help people grow

You know how to turn product goals into reality. You are used to work in fast-paced startups and are a driver to increase velocity.

Product-minded.

Clear communicator.
You are able to explain complex technical things in details to Engineers and in an understandable way to non-technical stakeholders. You create alignment and motivate people 

Excited about AI-assisted development.
You are already using AI in your development workflow and are eager to explore how it can improve engineering speed, quality and the way teams work.

Who We Don’t Want

Pure people manager.
You no longer want to work directly on software. This role requires meaningful, ongoing involvement in architecture, implementation, code review, and technical problem-solving.

Hero engineer.
You want to make every important technical decision yourself or become the bottleneck for the team. Your job is to raise the effectiveness of the whole team, not to be the only person who can solve difficult problems.

Pure delivery manager.
You treat engineering as a ticketing operation focused only on timelines and task tracking instead of product quality, technical health, and team growth. We need engineering leaders, not project coordinators.

Product Manager: PMs own what and why; you own how (delivery) and who (people)

jobs.title: Staff Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Architecting the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

The Demand Core team and backend platform squads build the foundational infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure: downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. As a Staff Backend Developer, you will own the architectural integrity, reliability, and long-term evolution of the distributed systems that power these decisions 200 million times every day across multiple teams.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals like geo, fraud status, budget caps, to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. Beyond individual services, you will define architectural patterns across the entire ad interaction chain: high-throughput processing of clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer, and reward-triggering in-app events. You will govern our hybrid messaging architecture using SNS/SQS and Kafka, standardize backend data patterns across DynamoDB, relational, and analytical data stores, and ensure our core ad scoring pipelines remain resilient under massive load.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

• 
Production Golang Systems & Architecture Mastery: You bring extensive backend development experience (7+ years, with deep production Go expertise in distributed environments). You will define service boundaries, concurrency models, and runtime optimizations for our +99% Go microservice architecture, scaling the platform reliably beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

• 
High-Throughput Event Streaming & Architecture Patterns: You have deep experience architecting and standardizing asynchronous microservice communication using event backbones like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will establish org-wide streaming standards, schema evolution, and CDC patterns to process billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

• 
Large-Scale Data Architecture & Platform Optimization: You understand database internals, distributed storage trade-offs, and low-level web standards. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

 

We’re hiring a Software Engineer to join our Core Data team in London.

This team builds the systems that power how Hudl understands sport at scale. From identifying players and teams across thousands of leagues to processing the moments that become highlights, stats and analysis, our services sit at the centre of Hudl’s platform.

You’ll work on the Global Sports Library (GSL), the backbone that connects identities, metadata and game context across Hudl products. That means designing APIs, distributed services and large-scale data pipelines that help ensure every product at Hudl is operating from the same understanding of the game.

The work is backend-heavy and deeply technical: data modeling, entity resolution, ingestion pipelines, consistency challenges, scalability and platform design. The systems you build won’t just support one product or one sport, they’ll become shared capabilities used across the company.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll:

  • Collaborate across disciplines. You’ll work closely with a cross-functional team of engineers, quality analysts, product managers and designers to build foundational data tools for the best of the best in sports.
  • Deliver backend-heavy features. Your team has the autonomy to build and maintain the GSL, ensuring market teams have access to reliable, comprehensive data infrastructure. We iterate rapidly and deploy changes to our products hundreds of times a day.
  • Propose new solutions. You’ll have the opportunity to solve complex technical challenges within the Core Data domain and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.
  • Thrive on the front lines. You’ll build pipelines and libraries that power every feature delivered to coaches and athletes, getting firsthand experience with how our data impacts the game.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Strong technical proficiency. You have at least three years of experience in engineering, specifically within backend-heavy or data-heavy environments.
  • Cloud experience. You’ve spent time working with cloud-based systems and services and are a strong advocate for TDD and CI/CD.
  • Experience navigating uncertainty. You’re comfortable taking on ambiguous work with many possible implementation options and identifying the one that pragmatically balances quality and immediate customer value.
  • A collaborative, team-first mindset. You understand that building great software is a team effort and you’re always willing to pitch in or provide quality feedback in code reviews.
  • Curiosity. You enjoy picking up new technologies and domains on the job. The idea of working across foundational layers of our stack and multiple products energizes you.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Tech stack knowledge. Professional background in C#, GraphQL, Elastic, MongoDB and AWS is ideal.
  • Data infrastructure background. Experience working in environments with significant data scale and complex infrastructure needs.
  • Familiarity with hybrid teams. You’ve worked with hybrid or remote teams before and can adapt quickly to our international working environment.

Full-Stack Engineer - Broker Terms Team

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join the Broker Terms team.

You’ll build the systems behind every offer iwoca makes through brokers, and see your work in the terms each business gets.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Broker Terms is a growing team that owns the full offer terms strategy for businesses that come to iwoca through a broker – both first-time and repeat customers. It sets pricing, loan amounts, durations, and broker commissions, and owns the offer user interface (UI) brokers use in the Introducer Portal. The broker network is iwoca's biggest acquisition channel, and the team is directly responsible for the terms that win those customers.

The team is small and interdisciplinary – commercial strategy, engineering and data science. It turns business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into timely decisions. It works on short-term gains and longer-term bets, and judges both by Customer Lifetime Value – what a business is worth to iwoca across all its borrowing.

There are no fixed office days, and the team meets up for lunch once or twice a month.

The role

As a full-stack engineer in Broker Terms, you'll make changes across iwoca's codebase wherever they'd improve an offer. Most of it is backend – the code that calculates each offer's terms – with some frontend on the UI where brokers see them.

You'll own features and projects from scoping and design through to production, and choose how to build them. You'll help decide what goes on the team's roadmap. You'll learn from the team's experienced engineers, and from the people who price broker offers.

The team is light on process – a daily stand-up, a weekly meeting and regular retrospectives – and you'll have a say in how it works. Brokers see your changes in the Introducer Portal, and A/B tests show you which ones raised Customer Lifetime Value. Your work helps businesses get the funding they need.

Live project examples:

• 
Model-based pricing. Developing the systems that let a model set bespoke pricing for each customer.

• 
No-fee test. Testing how the product performs without drawdown fees, and how that changes the way customers repay.

• 
Loan durations. Building longer-duration Flexi-Loans with flexible repayments.

• 
Offer display. Improving how offers appear to brokers and customers – a better journey, and easier testing for the team's data scientists.

• 
Commission systems. Upgrading iwoca's broker commission systems.

The requirements

Essential:

• 
Backend engineering. You've designed and built backend systems that run in production, ideally in Python, Django and PostgreSQL. You've modelled their data with performance and maintenance in mind.

• 
Frontend engineering. You've built and maintained user interfaces in production, ideally in TypeScript and React.

• 
Ownership. You've taken features end to end, and kept them working once people relied on them.

• 
Trade-offs. You've weighed delivery speed against the long-term health of a system, and can explain what you chose and why.

• 
AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

• 
Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

• 
DevOps. You've used containers and CI/CD pipelines to deploy your code.

• 
Experimentation. You've worked on A/B tests or other experiments, and used the results to decide what to build next.

• 
Product thinking. You've found the business need behind a feature request, and planned the technical work to meet it.

• 
Financial services. You've worked on lending, payments or pricing systems.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 to £85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

• 
Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

• 
Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

• 
Flexible working hours.

• 
Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

• 
A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

• 
25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

• 
A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

• 
Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

• 
3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

• 
An employee equity incentive scheme.

• 
Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

• 
Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

• 
Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

• 
A learning and development budget for everyone.

• 
Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

• 
Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Nomios’ mission is to build a secure and connected future. Organisations across the globe depend on us to help secure and connect their digital infrastructures.

As part of our continued UK growth, we are expanding our Professional Services capability and seeking a Security Engineering Consultant to deliver specialist security engineering and operations consultancy across our customer base.

This is a hands-on technical role within the Security Operations domain, focused on helping customers improve and automate their SOC functions, tooling, and detection capabilities. You will work across a range of technologies and engagements, from SOAR and SIEM implementation through to vulnerability management, exposure management, and process automation.

Your role as Senior Security Engineering Consultant

The Security Engineering Consultant role sits within the Security Operations Team, working directly with the Nomios SOC Engineering team.

This is a senior, customer-facing Professional Services role within our Security Engineering function, focused on detection engineering and automation. You will lead the design and delivery of detection and response capabilities across SIEM, XDR and SOAR platforms. This includes building detection rules, developing automations, and creating operational playbooks that support effective SOC outcomes.

A key aspect of the role is ownership of the detection as code approach, ensuring detections and automations are developed, structured and delivered in a consistent and scalable way. Working directly with customers, you will define detection strategies, design use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, and guide improvements in visibility, coverage and response maturity. You will work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams, supplementing them with specialist expertise in detection engineering and automation, rather than focusing on platform deployment itself. 

The role combines hands-on engineering with advisory responsibilities, with a clear focus on delivering high-quality outcomes and enabling customers to operate and evolve their detection capabilities.

Responsibilities

Deliver

Design and deliver detection rulesets across SIEM and XDR platforms

Develop and tune detection logic using KQL or equivalent query languages

• 
Design detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and real-world attack techniques

• 
Map customer log sources to detection use cases to assess coverage and identify gaps

• 
Design and implement SOAR automations, integrations and response workflows

• 
Develop and document customer incident response playbooks aligned to detection outputs

Translate threat intelligence and operational learnings into improved detections and automations

Deliver detection as code pipelines, including structured use case development and versioning approaches

Support SOC teams by ensuring delivered outputs are practical, usable and aligned to operational workflows

Improve

Contribute to the continuous evolution of detection use cases, playbooks and automation patterns

• 
Support development of reusable detection content and delivery standards

• 
Contribute to lab work, testing and validation of detection approaches

• 
Identify gaps in telemetry, logging and enrichment, and provide recommendations to strengthen detection outcomes

Strong hands-on experience with SIEM engineering, including developing and tuning detection rules, with Microsoft Sentinel preferred

Experience writing detection logic using KQL or similar query languages

Proven experience designing and implementing SOAR automations and playbooks such as Logic Apps, Cortex XSOAR or similar

Technical Competencies

SIEM and XDR platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Palo Alto XSIAM or XDR, CrowdStrike and SentinelOne

Log source mapping and normalisation to support detection use cases

Network Detection and Response technologies such as Vectra AI, Corelight or similar

Cloud security and telemetry, particularly within Azure environments

Threat intelligence integration and enrichment to support detection and response

Development of customer playbooks and response workflows aligned to SOC operations

General awareness of emerging technologies, including AI-driven security tooling and their application within detection and response

jobs.title: Solutions Architect - Search Specialist
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role

At Elastic, we're revolutionizing the search and data analytics space. We're pioneers in the integration of Gen AI, powerful retrieval models like ELSER, and cutting-edge semantic search technologies like vector search, empowering businesses to unlock unprecedented insights and experiences.

As a Search Solutions Architect, you'll be at the forefront of this transformative journey. You'll play a pivotal role in designing and deploying innovative solutions that leverage the combined power of these technologies, helping organizations unlock the full potential of their data. Your work will directly influence the success of organizations worldwide, helping them unlock new opportunities and make insightful decisions. 

Are you ready to join the Elastic Revolution and be a pioneer in the next generation of Search powered AI? Apply now and embark on this exciting journey with us! We're eager to welcome you to a team that's shaping the future and helping organizations unlock the full potential of their data.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Architect next-generation search solutions: Design and implement cutting-edge solutions utilizing Elastic's latest advancements in AI, semantic search, and vector search, including RAG, vector databases, and other emerging technologies.
  • Harness the power of ELSER: Enable organizations to achieve unparalleled accuracy and efficiency in their search queries and data retrieval processes, leveraging the capabilities of the Elastic Learned Sparse Encoder.
  • Unlock the potential of vector search: Implement powerful vector search algorithms and create high-dimensional vector representations of data, allowing users to find the information they need even with imprecise queries.
  • Deliver compelling proof-of-concept (POC) projects: Showcase the combined value of AI, semantic search, vector search, and ELSER through successful POCs, demonstrating the potential for improved search relevance, user experience, and decision-making.
  • Become a thought leader and evangelize our vision: Share your expertise through presentations, blog posts, and other channels, positioning Elastic as the leader in AI-powered search and semantic data exploration.
  • Cultivate a collaborative environment within the Solutions Architecture team and across departments, promoting knowledge sharing and driving continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, data scientists, and industry experts who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of search and AI-powered solutions.
  • Continuously learn and explore the ever-evolving landscapes of AI, semantic search, vector search, and related technologies, ensuring your solutions are always at the forefront of innovation. We provide access to world-class training programs and cutting-edge technology.

 

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in designing and architecting enterprise-level search solutions.
  • Deep understanding of AI and semantic search technologies, with a focus on RAG, vector search, and NLP.
  • Familiarity with emerging ecosystem technologies and how they interoperate like Hugging Face, Langchain, etc.
  • Solid knowledge of ELSER's architecture and other models within the Hugging Face ecosystem.
  • Experience with vector databases and other emerging data storage solutions.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. We think of it like this, “ You may be speaking to a developer in the morning, an architect in the afternoon and an executive buyer in the evening.”
  • Collaborative spirit and a passion for sharing knowledge and expertise.
  • Unwavering commitment to continuous learning and staying ahead of the curve in technology and emerging trends.
  • Fluency in Spanish would be an advantage. 

 

#LI-PF1

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

jobs.description:
About the Job:

As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you will play a pivotal role in nurturing and expanding relationships with large enterprise accounts within your designated territory. You should possess exceptional business acumen, a customer-centric approach, and the self-motivation to thrive with minimal supervision. Moreover, you must be adaptable and proficient in wearing multiple hats as you take on this crucial responsibility. We have full confidence in your ability to make the right decisions and drive results autonomously.

LaunchDarkly is a rapidly evolving software company with a strong mission and vision, powered by a diverse and talented team. Our mission is to accelerate software development by empowering teams. Joining our dynamic and fast-growing team, you will make an immediate impact on our product and customer success.

Responsibilities:

  • Ownership of Large Enterprise Accounts: You will be the primary point of contact and relationship owner for large enterprise accounts within your territory.
  • Territory and Account Planning: Develop comprehensive territory and account plans, proactively drive outbound pipeline generation independently, and collaborate effectively with Business Development Representatives.
  • Ensure Successful Adoption: Ensure the seamless adoption of LaunchDarkly within these large enterprises through robust account management. Coordinate closely with pre-and-post sales engineering, customer success, and support teams to guarantee client satisfaction.
  • Elevate LaunchDarkly's Visibility: Increase LaunchDarkly's visibility and communicate our value proposition effectively to Vice Presidents and C-Suite executives within these large enterprises.
  • Collaboration with Solutions Engineers: Work closely with your solutions engineer counterpart to deliver both business and technical value to prospects and customers.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams, including product support, developer relations, marketing, and revenue operations, to align our offerings with customer business needs effectively.

About You:

  • Entrepreneurial and Self-Motivated: You are driven and proactive, taking ownership of your role and responsibilities.
  • Passion for Learning and Growth: You are enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development at LaunchDarkly.
  • Intellectual Curiosity and Ambition: You have a hunger for knowledge and strive for ambitious goals.
  • Excellent Communication: Your written and spoken communication skills are outstanding.
  • Highly Organized & Autonomous: You are capable of efficiently managing your workload and thrive in an environment that encourages autonomy.
  • Adaptability: You excel in a fast-paced and dynamic organizational setting.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of Enterprise (closing) Sales Experience

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual.

For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less.

This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

• 
Product Strategy & Execution: 

• 
Own the product direction for Carwow's dealer-facing product, defining what we build, in what order, and why

• 
Lead discovery work with dealers, interviews, on-site visits, data analysis to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

• 
Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into dealer workflows: smarter recommendations, vehicle pricing, performance insights that actually change behaviour

• 
Collaborate with Tech Lead, Designer, and Engineers to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

• 
Manage the backlog with commercial awareness prioritising work that drives engagement, retention, and revenue, not just activity

• 
Partner Engagement & Insight:

• 
Build relationships with key dealer partners and use those relationships to validate product direction before we build

• 
Work with Account Management and Sales to understand what's driving churn, what's blocking adoption, and what would make carwow stickier

• 
Translate qualitative partner feedback into structured product insight; don't just collect opinions, turn them into decisions

• 
Cross-functional Leadership:

• 
Work across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

• 
Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

• 
Support the commercial team on partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• 
1.5+ years of product management experience in a B2B or SaaS environment, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

• 
Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

• 
Genuine curiosity about AI, you follow what's happening, you have a point of view on where it adds real value, and you're eager to experiment

• 
Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve

• 
Strong stakeholder instincts, you can build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, and senior stakeholders without losing your own point of view

• 
Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

• 
Experience in automotive, marketplace, or dealer-facing products

• 
Familiarity with gamification or engagement loop design in a B2B context

• 
Background in scale-up or high-growth environments

• 
Experience taking new products to market, including GTM planning and launch

INTERVIEW PROCESS

• 
Step 1: Talent Screening Call (30 min)

• 
Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min)

• 
Step 3: Case Study (60 min + Task)

• 
Step 4: Values Interview (45 min)

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

• 
Hybrid working

• 
Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

• 
Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

• 
Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

• 
Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

• 
Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

• 
Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

• 
Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

• 
28 days annual leave

• 
1 day for your wedding

• 
1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

• 
For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

• 
For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

• 
Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

• 
Work from abroad for a month

• 
Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

• 
Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

• 
The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

• 
Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

• 
Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

• 
Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

• 
Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.company: OLR Holdings Ltd trading as DFYNE
jobs.description:
Role: Senior Data Engineer

Location: DFYNE HQ, 1 Forrest Gate, Uddingston, G71 5PG

Work Location: Onsite

About You:

Are you the kind of Data Engineer who enjoys being the person everyone relies on when data matters most? Do you thrive on building reliable pipelines, improving data quality and ensuring critical business decisions are driven by trusted information? Are you as comfortable writing complex SQL as you are building automated monitoring, troubleshooting failures and improving data architecture? If you enjoy ownership and want to have a direct impact on how a fast-growing business operates, DFYNE could be exactly where you belong.

About DFYNE:

A picture paints a thousand words… and we’re sure you don’t want to sit here reading a corporate essay about who we are. Honestly, how can you really get under the skin of DFYNE from a few lines on a screen? So instead, go have a look for yourself, see what we’re about, what we stand for, and why people love us: www.dfyne.com.

About the role — DFYNE Your Career:

Before I tell you more about the role, let me introduce myself. I’m Bruce, Head of Development at DFYNE, and I’m looking for our first dedicated Senior Data Engineer. This role will own the DFYNE data warehouse, helping ensure the data that powers finance reporting, forecasting, inventory management and operational decision-making remains accurate, reliable and available. You’ll take ownership of BigQuery pipelines, transformation layers, exports and integrations while working closely with teams across the business. This is a hands-on role where you’ll help define data engineering standards, improve data reliability and build the foundation of DFYNE’s future data capability.

Attitude:

• Ownership mentality
• Builder mindset
• Commercial awareness
• Problem-solving mindset
• Continuous improvement

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the performance, reliability, security and ongoing development of DFYNE’s BigQuery data warehouse and associated data pipelines.
• Design, build and maintain scalable ingestion and transformation processes.
• Implement data quality monitoring, validation and automated alerting.
• Define data contracts with business stakeholders and system owners.
• Improve reliability, accuracy and freshness of business-critical data.
• Lead investigation and resolution of data incidents, ensuring root causes are identified and permanently addressed.
• Support ERP, finance, forecasting and operational reporting requirements.
• Build and maintain integrations for fulfilment and logistics platforms.
• Identify and resolve data quality issues and pipeline failures.
• Contribute to data architecture, governance and engineering standards.
• Collaborate closely with Finance, Operations and Engineering teams.
• Support reporting, analytics and business intelligence initiatives.
• Drive continuous improvement across DFYNE’s data platform.

Skills & Experience:

• 5+ years of commercial Data Engineering experience.
• Expert SQL skills and strong Python development experience.
• Hands-on BigQuery experience or equivalent cloud data warehouse technologies.
• Experience with dbt, Dataform or similar transformation frameworks.
• Experience building and operating production data pipelines.
• Experience implementing monitoring, testing and alerting for data systems.
• Strong understanding of data quality, governance and reliability.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Experience supporting finance, ERP or operational reporting environments.
• Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.

Nice to Have:

• Google Cloud Platform certifications.
• Logistics, fulfilment or e-commerce experience.
• Terraform and Infrastructure as Code experience.
• Experience with modern analytics and reporting tools.
• Experience scaling data platforms in high-growth businesses.

So, what’s in it for you?:

If you’ve made it this far down without being put off, brilliant. I’d genuinely love to hear from you. Beyond joining a work family and a genuinely great place to build your career, you’ll become DFYNE’s first dedicated Data Engineer and help shape the future of data within one of the UK’s fastest-growing companies. You’ll work on a modern data platform supporting finance, forecasting, ERP and operational decision-making while having genuine ownership and influence from day one.

You’ll be part of a high challenge; high reward culture.

What will aid a successful application with DFYNE:

• Cover letter
• Completed questionnaire

Salary starting from £65k per year.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Introduction

We’re expanding and have a fantastic opportunity for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our mechanical and biomedical engineering department. We want to deepen and broaden the skills we already have in the group, and to add to its great culture. This role would suit someone in the early stages of their career, looking for a new challenge within an innovative company.

This team works predominantly across healthcare projects, and you will use your engineering skills at all stages of the development life-cycle, taking responsibility for design challenges and technical problems.

There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

 

What you’ll be doing

The majority of your time will be spent delivering exceptional mechanical engineering for our multi-national medical technology clients, understanding their requirements and communicating clearly and effectively. You will be hands-on in solving complex mechanical challenges, often alongside other disciplines, within supportive project teams.

You will work on projects across a range of healthcare sectors, including medical devices, drug delivery, surgical systems and diagnostics instruments. The technical challenges we tackle are ground-breaking, innovative and make a real difference to the landscape of medical technology.

You will guide aspects of the mechanical development and define technical solutions, using your experience to design systems and parts for manufacture by applying real-world knowledge. Your work is likely to include:

  • First-principles engineering analysis
  • Concept generation and the development of engineering designs
  • Rapid prototyping
  • Hands-on testing and experimentation, including the design and execution of test programmes
  • Detailed design for manufacture and assembly, and liaising with suppliers
  • Presenting results, both internally and to clients
  • Preparing technical reports and producing high-quality documentation

Our culture encourages team members to take on the level of responsibility that suits them. You will have the opportunity to significantly develop your skills and career, learn from others and make a substantial impact on our projects.

We are keen to support the development of our employees, and as such offer an extensive in-house training program. As you advance within the organisation there will be plenty of opportunities for you to develop your technical skills and specialism, take on more leadership responsibilities and/or focus more on supporting the development of sales opportunities.

 

What you can bring

You’ll bring strong mechanical engineering ability and enthusiasm to the role. You will deliver high-quality work on client projects, to specification and to timelines. You will be responsible for delivering the tasks you’re assigned, and for defining tasks for yourself and often for others.

We’re looking for applicants who can demonstrate:

  • An excellent undergraduate degree in Mechanical Engineering (or a related subject such as Biomedical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or Mechatronics) or equivalent experience
  • Design engineering industry experience, for example (but not limited to) high proficiency in CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), design analysis, structural analysis, rapid prototyping, technical drawings, design for manufacture and design for assembly
  • A proven track record of working in a diverse team and of successful delivery
  • A creative and analytical approach to problem-solving and concept generation
  • Strong written and verbal communication

In addition, experience in any of the following would be advantageous (but is not essential):

  • Experience in a consulting environment
  • Experience in medical device development, or other regulated product development
  • Familiarity with analysis tools such as Python/MATLAB, CFD and FEA
  • An interest in applying engineering to the biomedical field

 

What we do

Cambridge Consultants is one of the world’s leading product development and technology consultancies, with a reputation for cutting-edge design, development and value creation for a global client base. We develop breakthrough technology for some of the most exciting companies on the planet. Our people, facilities and work make us unique. Our medical technology division develops some of the most novel products, with tangible and often life-changing benefits for users and patients.

 

What we offer

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (with the option to buy 10 more a year)
  • Company bonus (profit share)
  • Flexible working patterns and hybrid working
  • Medical insurance and group income protection
  • Employee assistance programme and mental health support group
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave
  • Sabbatical leave
  • Travel insurance (business and leisure)
  • Generous company pension plan
  • Personalised career development and training plans
  • Free breakfast and two-course lunch in the office every day
  • Free onsite parking and we are close to public transport links
  • A variety of events organised by our social committee, ranging from summer and Christmas parties to board game nights and socials at our own rooftop bar!

 

Why Cambridge Consultants?

At Cambridge Consultants, you'll contribute to radical, new-to-the-world innovation that transforms business, society and the planet. Joining our multidisciplinary teams means helping to turn bold ideas into reality, harnessing the power of deep tech to create products, services and experiences that have never existed before. Whether you're advancing technologies, shaping strategy, supporting operations or driving commercial growth, it's an opportunity to make a real impact and help create the future.

jobs.title: Front-end Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

Comand AI is building a global technology leader focused on defense & security. The company was co-founded in 2023 by Loïc Mougeolle, Marie Inuzuka and Quentin Le Pape, drawing from their unique experience at defense industry leaders and world-class tech companies.

The world of defense & security are being entirely renewed by AI and robotisation: new classes of threats, new levels of autonomy and speed demands radically new solutions to protect our societies. Comand AI is at the forefront of the rebuilding of these verticals to serve our countries resilience.

Comand AI core product is a next generation command and control software platform, which allows militaries to operate at machine speed in a communication and GNSS denied context. A few facts to anchor you:

• 
€45M raised from seed to Series A, Blossom Capital leading the series A and Saab as a strategic investor

• 
Software platform combat proven and deployed in Ukraine

• 
A lean team of operators with backgrounds from Palantir, OpenAI and world-class tech experience, alongside unique expertise from the defense sector

• 
Live business with governments and defense industry leaders across Europe

• 
Paris (HQ), London, Munich and Kyiv subsidiaries

The Role

We are fully indexed on the success of every user, the interfaces you ship support live operations.

You'd join the product development team as a front-end specialist, working closely with product design and engineering. You take an operational problem, explore it, come back with proposals, and iterate. Delivering a clear, fast and dependable user experience is critical to the person using it.

What this looks like in practice:

• 
Own front-end delivery on Prevail, our operational planning platform, from interaction design through production

• 
Build interfaces for real geospatial problems: interactive maps, multiple data layers, large datasets, and time-sensitive workflows well beyond a typical CRUD application

• 
Work with product and design early, turning operational needs into clear flows and production-ready experiences

• 
Raise the front-end quality bar across the team by reviewing and improving work from engineers with different specialities, including AI-assisted code

• 
Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed and durability, especially when a high-stakes demo or deployment creates a short deadline

• 
Help create reusable patterns that make the product more coherent as the team and surface area grow

Who We're Looking For

We filter hardest on mission drive, low ego, attention to detail, and resilience under pressure. We want someone who cares about front-end engineering as a craft and can still move quickly when the problem is ambiguous.

Must-have:

• 
Strong production experience with React and TypeScript, with front-end engineering as a core part of your craft

• 
A track record of owning complex interfaces from problem definition through release and iteration

• 
Strong product and design judgement: you notice weak hierarchy, inconsistent interactions, and confusing states before a specification points them out

• 
Pragmatism and low ego: you can improve rough work from other engineers without turning every implementation choice into a philosophical debate

• 
Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities, while keeping the quality of what ships high

• 
EU or UK citizenship (contractual requirement tied to our defence contracts)

Nice to have:

• 
Experience with mapping, cartographic, GIS, or other geospatial applications

• 
Front-end performance work involving large or real-time datasets

• 
Experience building offline-capable or resource-constrained web applications

• 
Experience creating or scaling a design system

• 
Prior work in defence, government, or dual-use technology

What's In It For You

• 
A top 0.1% European compensation package, including base salary and equity

• 
Paris or London based

The Process

• 
Talent screening: 30 min, online. We cover your background, motivations, and what you want to own next.

• 
Front-end interview: 60 min, online. We assess React and TypeScript fundamentals, product judgement, and how you reason through an unfamiliar interface problem.

• 
Onsite in Paris: half day. You see the product, present a project you are proud of, and work through a front-end design and re-engineering exercise based on a realistic product problem.

• 
Roundtable: hiring committee reviews the full set of evidence and makes the final decision.

Players are waiting for your vision and ambition to build the next forever game a.k.a. the best work of your career. We back this up with creative and operational autonomy, and the infrastructure, capital, and experience needed to take a game from an idea to global scale.

jobs.description:
Director, Development Cost & Capital Planning (EMEA) 

Location: London, hybrid, with regular travel to project locations across EMEA

About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale is developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads. 

The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation. 

Nscale is working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company scaling globally with a key focus in the EMEA region.

The Role

The Director, Development Cost & Capital Planning is accountable for establishing cost certainty, capital planning, development risk and commercial viability across Nscale's EMEA Development portfolio from site identification (Gate 0) through due diligence (Gate 1) to development sanction and ‘shovel-ready’ transition into Delivery (Gate 2).

The role owns L0 Indicative Estimates, L1 Estimated Budgets and L2 Schematic Design Budget for every EMEA opportunity, consolidating the development, energy, design, construction, procurement and AI infrastructure workstream budgets into a single Total Development Cost (TDC) providing the commercial and financial foundation for site selection, land and lease acquisitions, Colocation leases, underwriting business cases, investment committee approvals and project approvals.

Operating as an individual contributor at first, the role will personally prepare estimates, cost models, risk registers, benchmarking and investment-grade business cases while establishing the systems, governance and processes required for future growth. The role will develop to manage a high performing team supporting the Development function as it expands across the EMEA region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Development Cost Planning & Estimating - Own L0, L1 and L2 estimates across the EMEA portfolio, maintaining the Total Development Cost (TDC), proforma and development cost baseline through Gate 2. Where early stage budgets have missing elements, propose and agree estimates and placeholders with the project team.
  • Investment Underwriting & Business Case Development - Provide CAPEX, contingency, cash flow and cost-risk inputs to support acquisitions, business cases and Investment Committee approvals.
  • Development Risk Management and Contingency Planning - Maintain project risk registers and govern contingency in accordance with Nscale policy.
  • Site Selection & Land Acquisition Support - Support site screening, due diligence and acquisition decisions through cost, risk and abnormality assessments.
  • Power, Utilities & Infrastructure Assessment - Integrate power, utility and enabling infrastructure costs and schedules into the overall development budget.
  • Procurement & Strategic Supply Chain Integration - Work with Procurement and Strategic Sourcing to incorporate market capacity, procurement strategy, long-lead items and supply chain risks into estimates.
  • Cost Benchmarking - Maintain EMEA cost benchmarks, escalation assumptions and market intelligence across key jurisdictions.
  • Contract / Lease Support - Support the Development team in all areas of land / power acquisition and Colocation leasing and contracting, providing cost annexes in the agreed contract form.
  • Market Intelligence - Retain current market benchmark costs and reintegrate as-built costs of developments into pre-development modelling and estimates.
  • Portfolio Capital Planning & Forecasting - Lead portfolio CAPEX forecasting, cashflow planning and variance reporting for all pre-sanction opportunities.
  • Development Governance & Gateway Approvals - Own cost deliverables, assurance and reporting for Gate 0-2 approvals.
  • Global WBS Alignment and Handover into Delivery - Structure all estimates to the Global WBS and lead commercial transition to Delivery at Gate 2.
  • Lessons Learned and Estimating Accuracy Improvement - Improve estimate accuracy, benchmarking and contingency calibration through estimate-to-outturn analysis.
  • Functional Leadership and Future Team Development - Act as EMEA lead for development cost planning, establishing standards, tools and governance with responsibility for building and leading the team as the portfolio scales.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in quantity surveying, cost management, estimating, commercial management or capital planning.
  • Proven experience within hyperscale data centres, mission critical facilities, major infrastructure, energy or industrial developments. 
  • The ability to build experienced based cost plans and budgets when limited information exists.
  • Strong understanding of the full data centre development lifecycle from site origination, early stage development, planning, permitting through construction mobilisation.
  • Experience preparing the cost basis for investment-grade business cases and underwriting budgets.
  • Experience developing risk registers, contingency models and portfolio capital plans.
  • Strong understanding of contractor markets, procurement strategies and supply chain dynamics.
  • Experience working with developers, investors, lenders, consultants and contractors.
  • Demonstrated ability to present to Executive Committees, Investment Committees and Board stakeholders.
  • Fluency in data centre cost benchmarking (€/MW, €/m², cost per IT load) and the development cost drivers of power, cooling and AI-ready infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of EMEA contract forms and procurement routes (e.g. FIDIC, NEC and local equivalents) and their cost and risk implications.
  • Proficiency with estimating and cost management tools and advanced Excel-based cost and cash flow modelling.
  • Right to work [UK / EU] and willingness to travel across EMEA.

Preferred:

  • Degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Economics, Commercial Management, Engineering or related discipline.
  • MRICS, CICES, ACostE or equivalent professional accreditation preferred but not essential.
  • Experience across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.
  • Experience supporting large-scale AI, cloud, hyperscale or mission-critical developments.

Job title: Senior Data Engineer

Department: Data team

Reports to: Lead Data Engineer

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Permanent, local and full-time 

Starting date: ASAP 2026

PUR Description 

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

About the role 

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions that power analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in transforming raw project data into reliable, high-quality datasets through robust ETL processes, modern data architectures, and Python-based engineering practices. 

Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem. 

Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to: 

• 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python.

• 
Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes for large datasets.

• 
Design and maintain data models supporting reporting, analytics, and business applications.

• 
Implement and monitor data quality controls to ensure reliability and accuracy.

• 
Manage and optimize workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

• 
Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure).

• 
Support CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform).

• 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.

• 
Maintain technical documentation and promote data engineering best practices.

We are looking for someone with: 

• 
3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, with strong Python skills and experience building production-grade ETL pipelines.

• 
Strong SQL expertise and solid understanding of relational and analytical databases, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts.

• 
Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) and implementing automated testing for data pipelines.

• 
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform is a strong plus).

• 
Familiarity with AI tools (Claude is a plus).

• 
Strong knowledge of Git and software engineering best practices.

• 
Excellent problem-solving skills, focus on data quality and reliability, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.

• 
Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Recruitment process :

• 
Interview with the recruiter

• 
Interview with the manager and case study

• 
References check

At PUR, we strive to build inclusive teams and an equitable workplace where our employees feel respected, supported, and empowered. As a global company operating across six continents, we recognize that diversity in the workplace is essential to achieving our mission. 

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other aspect that makes them unique.

PUR is dedicated to providing an accessible environment for all candidates during the application process and for employees during their employment. If you require accommodation or consideration throughout the interview process, let us know, and we will do our best to support you.

jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer @Plato (backed by Hexa)
jobs.description:
⚖️ Who are we

Plato is building the AI OS for litigation lawyers.

With AI, the legal industry is on the verge of a major transformation. Litigation lawyers are overwhelmed by complex and repetitive tasks: complex damage calculations, thousands of documents to review, days spent drafting legal documents, and more.

Our mission: Build the leading AI OS for litigation lawyers, enabling professionals to work 5x faster, by putting their whole firm on autopilot.

Plato already supports more than 30 law firms and 1 major insurance company’s legal team, who use our solution daily to manage hundreds of active cases.

Founded in January 2026 by Ben (CEO) and Alexandre (CTO), we are backed by Hexa (formerly eFounders), Europe’s leading startup studio. Hexa has launched over 35 companies, including unicorns such as Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, collectively generating more than €230M in ARR and raising over €750M in funding.

Plato is live with real users, real data and real revenue, solving concrete legal workflows in production. We’re now looking for a Founding AI Engineer to help us turn the latest advances in AI into reliable products used every day by legal professionals.

🎯 Your mission

You’ll work directly with Alexandre , our CTO, at the intersection of AI, software engineering and product.

Your job is not to do AI research for the sake of research. You’ll experiment with models and approaches, understand what works, and turn the best solutions into reliable production systems.

You'll work on problems such as building agentic workflows, making sense complex legal documents, designing autonomous long-running agents, and improving the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs.

Responsibilities

Build AI-powered product features

• 
Design and ship AI features used directly by lawyers

• 
Be at the bleeing edge of the agentic stack: memory, sandboxes, code mode, lots of tools, subagents…

• 
Turn prototypes and experiments into production-ready feature

Work with complex data

• 
Extract, structure and reason over large volumes of unstructured legal documents

• 
Build robust data and document-processing pipelines

• 
Experiment with different models and approaches to improve accuracy and reliability

Make AI work in production

• 
Evaluate and improve agent outcomes through testing, evals and iteration

• 
Optimize systems for quality, latency and cost

• 
Build the backend services and infrastructure needed to run AI reliably at scale

Shape the product

• 
Work directly with the founders and users to understand real-world problems

• 
Move quickly from problem → experiment → production (think days, not weeks)

• 
Take ownership of your projects from exploration to deployment

🤩 This role is for you if

We're looking for a strong software or AI engineer with 2+ years of experience who wants to build real-world AI products at the forefront of the agentic stack.

You like working close to founders and users, making pragmatic technical decisions, and shipping software that actually runs in production.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

• 
Have a strong software engineering foundation, ideally with Typescript and experience shipping production systems

• 
Have experience with agents and/or evals and frameworks like Mastra, Eve, Pydantic, Langchain, etc…

• 
Can take an AI problem from experimentation to production

• 
Enjoy solving problems with no clear solution

• 
Have a strong product mindset and care about user impact

• 
Are autonomous and pragmatic, comfortable navigating early-stage ambiguity and shipping fast

⚙️ Our tech stack

Our stack is designed to support AI-first workflows and production reliability.

• 
Backend & Frontend: TypeScript, Node.js, React, tRPC

• 
Infrastructure: AWS (Terraform)

• 
Data & AI: Mastra, Bedrock

• 
Database: Postgres

You don't need to master every tool — what matters is your ability to design robust systems, learn fast, and make sound technical trade-offs.

💎 What we offer

• 
Build alongside a strong AI expert: Work closely with Alexandre, our CTO, who has deep expertise in AI agents, and turn cutting-edge AI into production systems.

• 
Ownership & Impact: As the second engineering hire, you'll have real influence on the product and technical direction

• 
Bring AI to real users: Build production AI systems that solve real problems in a complex, high-stakes domain

• 
Hexa ecosystem: Access to expertise, resources, and network from one of Europe's leading startup studios

• 
Competitive package: Attractive salary + meaningful equity

• 
Paris-based team: Work alongside the founding team in our office

• 
Growth: Opportunity to grow into a technical leadership role as the team scales

Plato is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation.

We know there's a long way to go regarding diversity in our industry, which is why we encourage all applicants to apply to our open positions.
