jobs.title: Corporate Paralegal
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

Mistral AI's corporate legal team is looking for a Corporate Paralegal to join our growing legal function in Paris. This is a newly created role designed to centralize and streamline the administrative backbone of our corporate legal operations as we scale internationally.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will own several critical workstreams end-to-end — from KYC and entity housekeeping to cap table management and contract administration — and you will be expected to exercise sound judgment, escalate when needed, and drive automation wherever possible.

What you'll do

1. Cap Table & Share Register

Own the cap table across different systems with rigor and precision. Record all share movements — issuances, transfers, ESOP/BSPCE, funding rounds. Maintain the legal share register and reconcile against articles, shareholders' agreements, and board minutes. Produce cap table extracts, shareholder lists, and ownership reports for KYC, audit, board packs, and investors — always under NDA and with judgment on what can be disclosed. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation) are essential.

2. Entity Management, Corporate Formalities & Notarisation

Handle entity creation from incorporation to corporate maintenance across jurisdictions (SAS, Inc, Ltd, Pte, GmbH, etc.) with confidentiality and attention to detail. Manage the annual formalities calendar, board/shareholder minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and the entity housekeeping file for each group company. Coordinate notarial formalities — share transfers, capital changes, statutory modifications, pledges. Handle apostilles, legalisation, and certified translations for documents used abroad via the Legal Vision Platform. Maintain up-to-date KYC packs for each entity: Kbis, articles, directors, beneficial ownership, administrative certificates. Respond to inbound KYC requests from banks, clients, and investors. Log every formalité for a complete and auditable record.

3. Insurance & Document Management

Manage insurance policies, certificates (COIs), and the renewal calendar. Handle COI requests by checking them against contractual requirements and following up with brokers. Keep a register of policies and claims. File and archive documents with naming conventions and versioning in our document management tools. Manage e-signatures (DocuSign). Maintain the contract register with expiry dates and notice periods. Provide up-to-date insurance certificates and policy summaries as part of KYC documentation for each entity.

4. Procurement Contracts

First-level review of NDAs, order forms, and simple SOWs against Mistral templates, flagging deviations for escalation. Version comparison and clean redlines. Understand the procurement policy to know when legal review is mandatory. Coordinate with Procurement, business teams, and Finance to move deals to signature. Complete supplier onboarding questionnaires (anti-bribery, sanctions, ESG, security) and supplier portals (Ariba, Coupa) as part of the vendor KYC process. Comfortable with tools like Ironclad, Notion, and Slack; keen to automate and reduce manual work.

What you bring

• 
10+ years of experience in a legal field, with a strong preference for corporate law (M&A, banking, funds, or large corporate groups).

• 
Experience in a law firm (corporate/M&A/banking), investment fund, bank, or a large multinational group (e.g., CAC 40).

• 
Proven experience with KYC processes, questionnaires, and administrative certificates.

• 
Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally.

• 
Hands-on experience with cap table management tools (Ledgy, Axiocap) or share register administration.

• 
Familiarity with French corporate law (SAS) and international entity structures (Delaware Inc, UK Ltd, Singapore Pte, German GmbH).

• 
Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and e-signature platforms.

• 
Exposure to procurement contract review and vendor onboarding.

• 
Fluent in English and French (both written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Are you ready to join us?

You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship
jobs.description:
Le poste

Les Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSE) travaillent directement avec les clients afin de comprendre rapidement leurs problèmes les plus importants et ainsi concevoir et implémenter des solutions qui vont utiliser leurs données afin de résoudre ces problématiques. Nos clients s’appuient sur les plateformes de Palantir pour certaines de leurs opérations les plus critiques, et les projets débutent souvent par une question ouverte, par exemple : « Comment évaluer le risque d’incendie de forêt et, par conséquent, comment optimiser le réseau électrique ? » ou « Comment évaluer rapidement notre chaîne d’approvisionnement alimentaire et l’adapter afin d’apporter à temps une aide vitale ? » En tant que FDSE, vous appliquez votre capacité à résoudre les problèmes, votre créativité et vos compétences techniques pour aider les organisations à exploiter au mieux leurs données et avoir ainsi un impact réel sur le monde. Vous avez l’opportunité d’obtenir des informations rares et de contribuer à certaines des industries et institutions les plus importantes au monde.

Responsabilités principales

En tant que stagiaire chez FDSE, vos responsabilités s’apparentent à celles que l’on trouve dans une petite start-up, tout en bénéficiant des ressources, de la stabilité et de l’accompagnement d’une entreprise technologique bien établie. Vous travaillerez en petites équipes avec une supervision minimale et serez responsable de l’exécution de bout en bout de projets à enjeux élevés. Votre journée peut consister à discuter de l’architecture avec d’autres ingénieurs, à gérer des données à grande échelle, à coder une application web personnalisée, à discuter avec l’équipe dirigeante du client ou à établir une stratégie pour votre équipe.

Les stagiaires FDSE sont traités exactement comme des ingénieurs à temps plein, et bénéficient d’une grande liberté et d’une grande autonomie dans leur travail. Ils assument la responsabilité des projets et des résultats réels sur lesquels nos clients comptent.

Nos principes:

• Impact : nous gérons des projets significatifs et enthousiasmants qui rendent le monde meilleur.

• Responsabilité : nous menons nos projets du début à la fin, en surmontant tous les obstacles que nous pourrions rencontrer. Nous nous faisons mutuellement confiance afin de gérer efficacement le temps et les priorités et donner aux individus l’espace nécessaire pour réfléchir par eux-mêmes.

• Collaboration : nous travaillons en interne avec des personnes d’horizons variés, tels que d’autres FDSE, des équipes Produits et des Deployment Strategists. Nous travaillons également en externe avec nos clients, souvent sur site, afin de comprendre et de répondre à leurs problèmes.

• Développement : nous pensons que l’apprentissage par l’expérience est l’une des meilleures écoles et nous nous encourageons nous-mêmes tout comme nos pairs à rechercher de nouveaux défis et de nouvelles opportunités de croissance, ainsi qu’à trouver de nouvelles façons d’innover et de partager les connaissances.

Le profil recherché

jobs.description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

As Senior Product Manager in our Pro Business Unit, you'll own the mid-market product line end to end. You'll lead a "pod" - a small, cross-functional team of a PM or designer, and 2-3 full-stack engineers - through the whole cycle: identifying the problem, shaping the solution, building it, shipping it, and measuring the result. You're the single point of accountability for that team.

The role blends product management, product design, and engineering judgment, all supported by AI tools. So we welcome candidates from a PM, design, or engineering background, as long as you're comfortable working across all three.

You'll report into the Product Engineering director within the BU, alongside other pods led by senior PMs, designers, or engineering managers.

Your impact at Brevo:

• Gather client signals and usage data and translate them into clearly defined problems, then shape the pitch — appetite, solution, risks and no-gos — and defend it at the betting table.

• Act as the pod's sole design reference: frame the user experience, make interaction and interface decisions, and create prototypes in line with our Naos design system leveraging Claude or our in-house prototyping tool.

• Run the build cycle against the pitch, using lightweight written status artefacts rather than recurring status meetings, and adjust scope rather than extend timelines.

• Agree on one or two measurable outcomes before the build begins, then deliver a clear post-launch verdict: continue, adjust, or discontinue.

• Own the launch: run the beta programme, equip PMM for go-to-market, and get Sales, CSM and Support ready ahead of release.

• Be the pod's single point of contact for the wider BU — surfacing risks early, coordinating with peer Pod Leaders, and applying AI tools by default across discovery, prototyping and analysis.

Who you are:

• You have a relevant background as a PM or Product Designer, or Lead Engineer — no single track is preferred.

• You can own an experience end-to-end: framing user problems, making interface/interaction decisions, and producing or validating prototypes (Figma and design-system literacy required).

• You have a go-getter, get-things-done mentality: you take initiative, push through ambiguity, and drive things to completion rather than waiting to be told.

• You can write and defend a complete pitch: problem, appetite, sketch, rabbit holes, no-gos and success metrics.

• You have a track record of shipping against a committed appetite using lightweight, async cadence artefacts (e.g. hill charts) rather than heavyweight Scrum rituals.

• You're comfortable pulling and interpreting usage data (Amplitude, funnel, retention) and running discovery interviews to turn signals into problem statements.

• You're tech-credible: comfortable reading AI-generated code and partnering with a Lead Engineer on trade-offs — and you integrate AI tools by default into your day-to-day work, with a critical validation step on their outputs.

• You are fluent in English and in French

A place to grow together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.

• 

Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package, and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).

• 

Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.

• 

Flexible for life: A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.

• 

Wellbeing that works: Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick, and several services related to prevention, health, and personal and professional wellbeing on the Welii platform.

• 

A culture that cares: From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You'll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto.

Ajax Systems est une entreprise technologique internationale et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de sécurité en Europe, comptant plus de 4,5 millions d'utilisateurs finaux et 330 000 utilisateurs PRO dans plus de 180 pays à travers le monde. L'entreprise propose des solutions complètes pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur envergure. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs dédiés à la protection contre les intrusions, à la vidéosurveillance, à la sécurité incendie, à la protection des personnes, ainsi qu'au confort et à l'automatisation. L'entreprise compte 5 000 collaborateurs.

Nous constituons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts du terrain sont les mieux placés pour appréhender les spécificités de chaque marché. L'entreprise est représentée commercialement dans le monde entier, notamment en Italie, en Espagne, en Allemagne, en France, au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Australie, en Afrique du Sud et dans de nombreuses autres régions.

L'équipe mondiale de Développement Commercial rassemble des collaborateurs partageant les mêmes valeurs et les ambitions d'Ajax Systems. L'alliance du meilleur logiciel et d'un matériel haute performance a définitivement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur. Présente dans les plus grands salons spécialisés — IFSEC, Expoprotection, Intersec — et récompensée par des prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence tels que PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax figure aujourd'hui parmi les systèmes de sécurité les plus primés d'Europe.

La production d'Ajax Systems repose sur quatre usines : deux implantées en Ukraine, une en Turquie et une au Vietnam. La certification ISO 14001 de l'entreprise garantit un impact environnemental maîtrisé tout au long du processus de fabrication. Le choix des composants entrant dans la conception des dispositifs Ajax est conditionné par la fourniture de déclarations de fabricants attestant de leur conformité aux exigences RoHS.

L'entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre. La résilience est donc au cœur de l'ADN de la marque, et la lutte contre le mal — par la création des meilleurs dispositifs de sécurité et d'automatisation — constitue la mission indéfectible d'Ajax.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority.

About this role:

Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements

• Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe.

• Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets.

• Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale.

• Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery.

• Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are.

• Negotiate scope and delivery commitments with engineering leadership, and re-plan when capacity or mission timelines shift.

• Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions.

Communicate

• Own internal communication on your perimeter: keep engineering, program leadership, and executives working from the same technical reality.

• Develop the technical narratives and proof points that marketing and BD then turn into their own customer-facing material.

• Prepare recommendations and presentations for top-executive-level audiences.

• Structured and data-driven: you bring your experience and your intuitions, but when you put a recommendation on the table you can show the analysis it stands on.

• Real product obsession: you think about the bigger picture and product-market fit before you think about features.

• Relentless curiosity. In a single month you might move from a satellite bus constraint, to onboard AI inference, to a defense accreditation requirement — and you need to find that stimulating rather than exhausting.

Strategisches Denken und die Fähigkeit, es selbst in Abschlüsse umzusetzen.

Unternehmerischen Antrieb, Kreativität und den Mut, Neues auszuprobieren, auch wenn der Ausgang offen ist.

Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Softwareprojekte funktionieren, und Neugier für die Veränderungen durch KI.

😍 40-Stunden-Woche (4.5% weniger als CH-Durchschnitt)

jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position Description

We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.

What you will do

Data Architecture & Engineering

• 

Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free.

• 

Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs.

• 

ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions.

• 

Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.

Technical Customization & Custom Development

• 

Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines.

• 

Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages.

• 

Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks.

API & Ecosystem Integrations

• 

Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform.

• 

Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync.

• 

Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.

Platform Operations & System Health

• 

Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime.

• 

Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).

• 

Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure.

Experience and qualifications

Core Technical Competencies

• 

Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning.

• 

Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman.

• 

Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech.

• 

MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization.

Experience

• 

3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks).

• 

Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing.

• 

Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools.

Key Personality Traits

• 

Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends.

• 

Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges.

• 

Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Position:

Sonar is looking for an Inside Sales Executive to join a Major Accounts pod and support two Major Account Managers in covering a portfolio of key accounts end to end. You will help the pod reach complete coverage of each account by prospecting into entities that are not yet customers and supporting entities that already run Sonar instances. You will own the full sales cycle on the opportunities you source: qualification, proof of concept, business case, negotiation with procurement and close.

On a daily basis, you will

• 

Partner with two Major Account Managers in a pod model to build and execute account plans that give full coverage of key accounts and their business units

• 

Generate new leads and opportunities in entities of key accounts that are not yet Sonar customers, using a multi-channel approach (LinkedIn, email, video, cold calls and meetings) to convert identified prospects into new logos

• 

Work with channel partners to generate and grow pipeline within the accounts you cover

• 

Engage and grow entities that already run Sonar instances, identifying new teams, use cases, products and editions

• 

Qualify opportunities with BANT and MEDDPICC to understand the customer's needs, pains, decision process, economic buyer and champion

• 

Run discovery calls and demos, and guide prospects through proofs of concept and trials with Solutions Engineers, validating Sonar's value against agreed success criteria

• 

Size and quote customer software license needs

• 

Build the business case and mutual action plan with the customer, then drive the deal through stakeholder alignment, security and legal review, negotiation with procurement, and signature

• 

Capture all account and opportunity information accurately in Salesforce (stage, next steps, forecast category, MEDDPICC fields), and use it to set daily activity and forecast the pipeline

• 

Support Marketing with account-based, customer-focused campaigns, and work with SDRs, Customer Success and Sales Operations to hand over smoothly after the sale

• 

Meet or exceed quarterly and yearly targets for pipeline creation and bookings

• 

Share customer and competitive insights, and proactively build, grow and share sales team best practices

The skills you will demonstrate

• 

Have 2 to 5 years of experience in a B2B sales role (Inside Sales, SDR/BDR moving into an AE role, Account Executive or Account Manager), ideally in a SaaS or subscription model

• 

Have a proven track record of creating pipeline and closing deals, with exposure to the full sales cycle from prospecting to negotiation

• 

Know a structured qualification methodology such as BANT and MEDDPICC, and apply it consistently to understand customer needs, pains and decision processes

• 

Have experience selling a technical product to a technical buyer, as well as to business stakeholders such as security teams and procurement

• 

Have proven prospecting skills across channels and tools such as Outreach, ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn, calling and networking

• 

Be familiar with selling to and negotiating with mid-market and enterprise customers, including deals above 20k USD

• 

Communicate confidently with executive-level contacts and tailor value messages to the persona, with both bottom-up and top-down approaches

• 

Be comfortable running discovery calls, demos and technical evaluations or POCs alongside a Solutions Engineer

• 

Be able to negotiate commercial terms and navigate procurement, legal and security reviews through to signature

• 

Have Salesforce expertise and be highly organized: manage many accounts and opportunities in parallel, with accurate CRM hygiene and forecasting

• 

Be customer-centric: we want happy customers

• 

Show strong communication and listening skills, handle objections well, and welcome feedback and coaching

• 

Be a self-driven, proactive and hungry team player who works well in a pod structure with senior Account Managers and cares about team and company goals

• 

Have experience selling software development tooling or selling into the development side of IT, and closing deals internationally (a plus)

• 

Be curious about how AI-assisted development changes code quality and security

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. jobs.title: IT System Engineer (w/m/d), 80–100 %
jobs.description:
Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen.

Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht.

Über Dukers

Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen.

Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen.

Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir.

Deine Aufgaben

• 
Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson.

• 
Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online.

• 
Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig.

• 
Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit.

• 
Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein.

• 
Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt.

Womit du arbeitest

• 
Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure

• 
Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox

• 
Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba

• 
Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco

• 
Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben

• 
Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln

Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür.

Das bringst du mit

• 
Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• 
Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender

• 
Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort

• 
Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären

• 
Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

• 
Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen

• 
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• 
Führerausweis Kategorie B

Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt.

Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze

Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Wir suchen dich in St. Gallen und Umgebung.

Das Büro liegt verkehrsgünstig: Die Autobahnein- und -ausfahrt Kreuzbleiche ist drei Minuten entfernt, Winkeln fünf. Die Bushaltestelle Schönenwegen liegt eine Minute vor der Tür. Parkplätze sind kostenlos. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan.

Was dich bei Dukers erwartet

• 
Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest.

• 
Fünf Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr: Bezahlt und für Zertifizierungen, Kurse oder Herstellertrainings nutzbar – wir fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung aktiv.

• 
Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Dukers wächst, und wer diesen Erfolg mit erarbeitet, soll daran teilhaben. Deshalb beteiligen wir unser Team jedes Jahr am Unternehmenserfolg – zusätzlich zum Lohn.

• 
Fünf Wochen Ferien, bei Bedarf mehr: Bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen pro Jahr kannst du unkompliziert dazukaufen.

• 
Arbeit, die zu deinem Leben passt: Familie, Weiterbildung, Sport oder ein Projekt, das Zeit braucht: Wir richten die Anstellung nach deiner Lebenssituation aus – mit einem Pensum von 80 % oder 100 %, Gleitzeit und Remote Work nach Absprache. Und wenn sich dein Leben verändert, verändern wir das Modell mit.

• 
E-Firmenfahrzeug mit Privatnutzung: Ohne Zusatzkosten für dich, inklusive Ladepauschale. Und wenn du zu Hause laden willst, beteiligen wir uns an deiner eigenen Ladestation.

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

About the role

• 
What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

• 
Where you'll work. You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.

• 
What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

What you'll do

• 
Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.

• 
Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

• 
Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.

• 
Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.

• 
Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.

• 
Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.

• 
Own it end-to-end. From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

We're excited about you because

• 
You have 4+ years of experience as a software engineer, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.

• 
You have 2+ years of professional Go experience, writing services that run in production, not side projects.

• 
You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

• 
You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

• 
You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.

• 
You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

• 
You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.

• 
You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

Strong plus

• 
Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.

• 
Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).

• 
Experience running multi-tenant systems.

• 
Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

What you'll get

• 
Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.

• 
Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.

• 
Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

• 
Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

• 
Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

• 
Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

• 
Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

• 
Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

• 
Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

• 
Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

• 
PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

• 
12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

• 
Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

• 
Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

• 
Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

• 
Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

• 
Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

• 
Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

• 
Management experience

• 
English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Make security the reason people trust Ockto

Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data

Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture.

As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide.

What you'll do

You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you:

• 
Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible.

• 
Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to.

• 
Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time.

• 
Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls.

• 
Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes.

• 
Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA.

• 
Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering.

• 
Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents.

• 
Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM.

• 
Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember.

Who you work with

You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters you also have a direct line to our CEO, and you are involved early in the product and architecture decisions that shape our risk. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you.

You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. They operate the technical controls as the first line; you set the requirements, verify and challenge as the second.

Outside Ockto, you work with the security, risk and procurement teams of our clients and with our external auditors. For audits you are the first line of planning, execution and communication with the auditor(s). Together with the Product & Trust Director, you are Ockto's security contact for DNB and AFM.

What you bring

You combine depth in security with the judgement to apply it pragmatically in a scale-up. We're looking for someone who:

• Has 8+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or similar.

• Has run an ISMS end to end and taken an organisation through ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits.

• Knows regulated financial services and works comfortably with DORA, PSD2, GDPR and supervision by DNB or AFM.

• Has solid grounding in cloud security, preferably AWS, and enough technical understanding to challenge engineers and judge designs.

• Thinks in risk: turns threats into priorities, and weighs security against cost and delivery speed.

• Communicates clearly at every level, from the management team and auditors to developers and a client's security officer.

• Is independent and principled: comfortable saying no, and good at finding the route to yes.

• Speaks and writes English fluently; Dutch is a strong advantage.

Will be a plus:

• CISSP, CISM, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification.

• Experience with privacy governance and DPIAs.

• Experience leading incident response, including notification to regulators.

• Experience with third-party risk management and assurance reporting such as ISAE 3402 or ISAE 3000.

• Familiarity with digital identity, eIDAS2 and EU digital identity wallets.

• Experience governing the safe use of AI tooling in a data-sensitive environment.

What you get

You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto.

• Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us.

• A real mandate: a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk.

• Influence on what we build next, as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions.

• Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work.

• Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance.

Ockto also offers:

• A good salary: between €5500,- and €6800,- per month, depending on experience

• Room and budget for personal and professional development

• A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice

• Phone and travel allowance

• Great home and remote working facilities

• Lunch fee

• Plenty of activities, including our annual ski trip, a 1.5-day team offsite, drinks and team outings

You'll join a team that values diversity and collaboration, in a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere.

About Ockto

Ockto is the leading platform for future-proof wallet services. For more than ten years we have been taking the friction out of sharing, verifying and enriching personal data, so that organisations and people can trust each other faster, based on the right information. From our office in Naarden, a team of specialists builds data-driven customer journeys that are right the first time.

Ockto. Built for trust.

Ready to join?

Do you see yourself as our new CISO? Then apply directly. After you apply, we'll contact you within five working days to discuss the role and answer your questions.

Want to know more first? Contact us at company culture, core values and recruitment process, or our other vacancies? Take a look at ockto.recruitee.com.

Your data is safe

At Ockto, we only use your CV and motivation letter during the application process to assess your application. If we don't proceed, we keep your application data for four weeks.

• 
Het analyseren van het huidige resourceallocatieproces en de rol van machine- en productiegegevens hierin;

• 
Het voeren van interviews met gebruikers om hun doelen, behoeften en knelpunten in kaart te brengen;

• 
Het onderzoeken welke data uit Insights en MRP relevant is voor besluitvorming;

• 
Het analyseren van gebruikersstromen, beschikbare data en bestaande schermen;

Het ontwikkelen van wireframes, gebruikersflows en ontwerpconcepten;

Het valideren en verbeteren van ontwerpen door middel van feedbacksessies met gebruikers en stakeholders;

Het vertalen van gebruikersbehoeften naar functionele requirements;

Het opstellen van een advies voor de integratie en presentatie van machinegegevens over verschillende platformen.

Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

With the Attendi App, we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.

Our product and development team is growing fast. Our Product Lead, a former nurse, owns the what and the why: our users, the roadmap and experiments. To keep up with the pace, we’re looking for someone who owns the how and the when: turning that roadmap into well-structured, realistic and predictable delivery, together with our development team leads.

Your Role
As Senior Product Owner at Attendi, you will:

• 
Translate roadmap items, experiments and MVPs into epics and user stories, with clear acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (performance, security, privacy, platforms).

• 
Own the development backlog in Jira: clear, up to date and one to two sprints ahead with work that’s ready to build.

• 
Set up and guard our Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.

• 
Prepare and lead refinement and sprint planning with our dev team leads.

• 
Propose 6-week cycle goals and sprint goals, based on capacity, dependencies, risk and effort.

Propose the balance between features, bugs, tech debt and maintenance.

Be the first point of contact for developers on tickets, and handle small scope questions yourself.

• 
Spot blockers, risks and delays early and solve them with the dev leads.

• 
Help turn uncertain AI work into small, measurable experiments.

• 
Accept delivered work, prepare phased rollouts and pilots, and write release notes for sales, implementation and support.

• 
Make sure our requirements are traceable from requirement to story, test and release, as required for our medical device (MDR) certification.

• 
Align technically with EHR vendors and partners on integrations, APIs and releases.

jobs.description:
We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.

Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended.

This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it.

Your Role
As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will:

• 
Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App.

• 
Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution.

• 
Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed?

• 
Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk.

• 
Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned.

• 
Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track.

• 
Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production.

• 
Help mature our design system in Figma.

You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

• 
2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints.

• 
Experience with B2B SaaS products.

• 
You start with questions, not solutions: who is the user, what is their context, what problem are we really solving?

• 
You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production.

• 
Strong Figma skills.

• 
Native Dutch speaker. You’ll talk with healthcare professionals a lot, in their own language.

• 
A portfolio that shows your thinking: the user, the problem, how you approached it and how you measured whether it worked.

Strong candidates may also

jobs.title: Hardware Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

Role Overview

As a Hardware Test Engineer at Optics11, you play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our fiber-optic sensing systems. You develop and execute hardware tests at board and sub-system level, identifying potential issues early and helping our engineers deliver robust, production-ready solutions.

Combining hands-on hardware engineering with test automation, you build test setups, analyze results, support prototype development, and help transfer testing processes from R&D to production.

You will be part of our Sensing Platform Team, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, production, and external partners.

What You'll Do

Hardware Testing & Automation

• 
Develop and execute test plans and procedures for electronic boards, assemblies, and sub-systems.

• 
Design and maintain test setups, fixtures, and jigs for functional, electrical, and optical testing.

• 
Perform environmental, stability, and robustness testing, including thermal cycling, vibration, and EMC/ESD pre-compliance.

• 
Develop Python-based test automation for instrument control, data logging, and analysis.

• 
Document test procedures, results, and findings, ensuring clear traceability and reproducibility.

Prototyping & Production Support

• 
Support prototype assembly, soldering, rework, cable assembly, and fiber handling and splicing.

• 
Develop and improve production and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) setups, procedures, and test jigs.

• 
Support troubleshooting, repairs, and root-cause investigations during development and production.

• 
Maintain an organized, safe, and well-equipped R&D laboratory, including equipment calibration and materials management.

Technical Analysis & Continuous Improvement

• 
Analyze test results to evaluate hardware performance, identify risks, and support engineering decisions.

• 
Investigate hardware failures and collaborate with design engineers on corrective actions.

• 
Contribute to design-for-test and design-for-manufacturing improvements.

• 
Identify opportunities to improve test methods, automation, and product reliability.

Collaboration & Delivery

• 
Work closely with Electronics, Photonics, Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, IVVQ, and production teams.

• 
Support the handover of tested hardware and documentation to integration, validation, and production teams.

• 
Independently plan and execute assigned activities, communicating progress, risks, and dependencies.

• 
Share technical knowledge, contribute to design reviews, and support continuous improvement across the team.

What we offer

• 
Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups.

• 
Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success.

• 
A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

• 
A competitive salary and benefits package.

• 
30 days of holiday per year.

• 
Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events.

Qualifications

• 
BSc (HBO) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.

• 
2+ years of relevant experience in hardware testing, test engineering, prototyping, or lab work on electronic or electro-optical products.

• 
Hands-on experience with laboratory instruments such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, and data loggers; experience with optical power meters is an advantage.

• 
Experience executing test plans and procedures, logging and analyzing measurement data, and documenting results in clear test reports.

• 
Good soldering and rework skills for through-hole and SMD components, including building custom cables and harnesses, and the ability to read schematics, PCB layouts, wiring diagrams, and assembly drawings.

• 
Experience with or good understanding of environmental testing (e.g. temperature, thermal cycling, vibration) and of EMC/ESD principles.

• 
Python skills for test automation, instrument control, and data analysis; experience with LabVIEW, embedded Linux or similar tools is advantageous.

• 
Awareness of ESD-safe working practices and lab safety, including laser safety, or willingness to be trained.

• 
A structured, practical, and hands-on working style, and real enjoyment of testing, finding problems, and getting hardware to work.

• 
Good communication skills in English and a collaborative working style.

• 
Eligible for EU/NATO security clearance.

Preferred

• 
Experience with fiber handling, connector cleaning and inspection, and fusion splicing.

• 
Experience with EMC pre-compliance measurements (e.g. EN 55032/CISPR 32 emissions, IEC 61000-4-x immunity) or environmental test standards (e.g. IEC 60068, MIL-STD-810).

• 
IPC certification (e.g. IPC-A-610 or IPC J-STD-001) or experience with ESD control programs (IEC 61340-5-1).

• 
Experience developing production test setups, test jigs, or programming fixtures, or supporting NPI and production transfer with electronics manufacturing partners.

• 
Experience in multidisciplinary high-tech product development (e.g. sensing, photonics, instrumentation, defence, or subsea).

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

jobs.title: Contract Sr Data Analyst (SQL,Telemetry,Browser Engine)

The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets.

Engineering Deliverables

  • Automated Dashboards: Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership.
  • Telemetry Gap Analysis: Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience.
  • Data Sanitization Frameworks: Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams.
  • Behavioral Inference Reports: Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends.

Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate

Scope

The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership.

Required Skills

  • Technical: Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable.

  • Soft Skills: Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights.

jobs.title: UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware
jobs.description:
🚀 Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware 

Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust.

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence.

Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads.

About the Role

As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer, you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy.

This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team.

The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better.

What You’ll Work On

• 
Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system.

• 
Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows.

• 
Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized.

• 
Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system.

• 
Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable.

• 
Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab.

Your Profile

• 
Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches.

• 
You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field.

• 
You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems.

• 
You are proficient in using CAD software, creating wiring diagrams, building electromechanic prototypes and defining and executing test campaigns across hardware disciplines.

• 
You are familiar with soldering, crimping, using multimeters, oscilloscopes, serial consoles, or other lab and field equipment, with at least basic experience in command line, data analysis tools and Linux usage.

• 
You are proactive, hands-on and able to find effective solutions also under the constraints of field-campaigns and willing to travel and deploy across Europe.

• 
You enjoy working directly with partners, operators, and end users. You can explain technical problems clearly, build trust in stressful situations, and represent SE3 professionally outside the lab.

• 
You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus. A driving license is required. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

• 
Specific knowledge in UAVs, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, flight log analysis, mission planning, and airspace coordination.

• 
Proficiency in PCBA and electronics circuit design and prototyping, especially targeting high-speed data interfaces and sensors

• 
Experience with development on ROS2, Docker, Linux, edge compute devices, C++/Python, Bash, Git, or deployment automation.

• 
Experience with networking and radio systems, including WiFi networks, LTE/5G modems, VPNs, telemetry links, antenna placement, RF interference, tactical communication links, and debugging connectivity issues in the field.

• 
Experience with perception or measurement systems, camera/IMU calibration, sensor synchronization, image processing, or mission autonomy.

• 
Skills interpreting sensor data, robot logs, flight logs, frequency-domain data, vibration issues, EMI issues, thermal issues, or intermittent hardware failures.

• 
Experience with environmental testing such as vibration, thermal, ingress protection, EMI/EMC, or MIL-STD-style qualification workflows.

• 
Experience creating acceptance tests, runbooks, troubleshooting- or training guides, fleet dashboards, release checklists, or field-support processes.

Perks & Benefits

• 
Real Ownership: Get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth

• 
Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you. We are an AI-first company empowering every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge.

31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

• 
Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

• 
Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece
