jobs.title: Principal Thermal Solutions Engineer - Paris/Grenoble
jobs.description:
Principal Thermal Solutions Engineer – Paris/Grenoble

About Vinci

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy and determinism of traditional simulation and the speed and scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world's most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market, and integrated into complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European technical sales team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci's platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating the transformative value of our software.

By acting as trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition, showcasing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and accelerated time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges, including both steady-state and transient thermal behavior. Your team will help customers evaluate critical factors such as thermal risk, component reliability, power density, and cooling efficiency to architect cutting-edge thermal management systems for next-generation hardware.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci's capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

• 
Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermal engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

• 
Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

• 
Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci's technical and business value.

• 
Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline, and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

• 
Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, and partner directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

• 
Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

• 
Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci's differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

• 
Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

• 
Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermal management and cooling solutions, either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

• 
Industry domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

• 
Customer engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

• 
Automation & scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

• 
Leadership impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

• 
Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

• 
Multiphysics breadth: Familiarity with structural mechanical simulations (FEA/stress) and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

• 
Commercial track record: Direct experience commercializing technical software, ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools, into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

• 
Go-to-market experience: Prior experience within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

• 
Emerging tech adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

• 
Don't just use AI; help redefine how next-generation hardware is designed.

• 
Work at the convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering.

• 
Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

À propos de Vinci

Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés et mis en production.

Présentation du poste

En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l’adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d’ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d’accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d’améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la physique thermique et des stratégies de refroidissement,

jobs.description:
About Parloa

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role

As a Sr Agent Architect at Parloa, you will act as a solution architect for enterprise AI Agent deployments. You will design end-to-end system architectures that connect Parloa's platform to complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions for global enterprise clients.

You will also shape the conversational experience layer, using prompt engineering and your knowledge of LLMs to translate customer requirements into agent behavior. Architecture and integration depth are the core of this role. Conversational design skills are valued and can be developed on the job.

Areas of ownership

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI Agent deployments, mapping how Parloa's platform integrates into customers' enterprise systems (CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, contact center platforms).
  • Build and configure integrations using integration platforms and APIs, applying systems thinking to solve complex, multi-system data flows.
  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios that go beyond standard integration capabilities.
  • Apply structured testing approaches to validate architecture, integration reliability, and AI agent performance under real-world conditions.
  • Identify and resolve blockers together with other departments at Parloa (e.g., Product, Solution Engineering, Sales) and the customer.
  • Scope AI Agent deployments, providing strategic architecture advice and execution support to customers and partners.
  • Use your knowledge of LLM internals (e.g., embeddings) to analyze customer requirements and design prompts for reliable, user-aligned agent behavior.
  • Translate complex customer workflows into structured conversational components that LLMs can execute reliably.
  • Fine-tune conversational flows and voice output (e.g., SSML, Lexicons, Regex) to align with customer brand standards.
  • Document best practices, how-to guides, and product capabilities for internal and external audiences, representing the expertise of the Agent Architect team.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing roles, with proven expertise in solution architecture, systems architecture, or enterprise integration.
  • Strong systems thinking, with a track record of solving complex technical problems across multiple systems and data sources.
  • Experience with complex SaaS implementations at scale (CRMs, ERPs, contact center platforms, ticketing systems).
  • Proficiency in REST API design, JSON/XML data structures, API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and API authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT).
  • Experience reading and consuming API documentation across enterprise SaaS platforms, including data transformation and field mapping logic.
  • Analytical and critical thinker with expertise in risk assessment and problem-solving.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a passion for meeting milestones and effective communication.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with initiative, results orientation, and ability to identify opportunities for impact.
  • Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into LLM prompts and conversational flows, with attention to subtle conversational nuance and A/B testing to assess agent performance. 
  • Prior conversation design, prompt engineering (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot learning), or A/B testing experience is a plus, not a requirement - we will train this.
  • Fluency in French and English is required

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.

We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier, and the rest of the tech team.

Your core responsibilities will be to:

Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

• 
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

• 
Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

• 
Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

• 
Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

• 
Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

• 
Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission

• 
Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

• 
Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

• 
Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

• 
Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

Example Projects

• 
Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

• 
Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

• 
Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.

We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here.

Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

About Linkup

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

• 
Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

• 
Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

• 
Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

• 
Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

• 
Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

Our Team

We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

• 
Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

• 
Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

• 
Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctorant en vision et apprentissage : Détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments
jobs.description:
Présentation de l’Ecole et du laboratoire

Créée en 1857, l’École Centrale de Lyon figure parmi le top 10 des écoles d'ingénieurs en France. Elle forme plus de 3 000 élèves de 50 nationalités différentes sur ses campus d'Écully et de Saint-Étienne (ENISE, école interne) : ingénieurs généralistes, ingénieurs de spécialités, masters et doctorants. Avec le Groupe des Écoles Centrale, elle dispose de 3 implantations à l’international. La formation dispensée bénéficie de l’excellence de la recherche des 6 laboratoires labellisés CNRS présents sur ses campus, des 2 laboratoires à l’international, des 6 réseaux de recherche internationaux et des 10 laboratoires communs avec des entreprises. Sa recherche d’excellence et son enseignement de très haut niveau lui permettent de nouer des accords de doubles diplômes avec des universités prestigieuses et des partenariats de pointe avec de nombreuses entreprises. Autour des thématiques de sobriété, d’énergie, d’environnement et de décarbonation, Centrale Lyon entend répondre aux problématiques des acteurs socio-économiques sur les grandes transitions.

Ce projet de recherche sera mené au sein du Laboratoire LIRIS (UMR 5205), et en particulier de l’équipe Imagine dont les travaux visent notamment à développer de nouveaux modèles d’apprentissage et de vision pour l’analyse et la compréhension de données visuelles telles que les images et vidéos.

Présentation de la thématique :

Cette mission s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet Therm_I_Bat associant le LIRIS à l’entreprise CMDL Manaslut Ing. et dont l’objectif est de proposer de nouvelles méthodes d’IA et de Vision par Ordinateurs pour la détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments.

Description de la mission

La performance énergétique réelle des bâtiments neufs ou rénovés reste souvent en deçà des performances visées en conception, créant un « energy gap » qui freine la décarbonation du secteur. CMDL a développé une solution robotisée capable de réaliser des campagnes de mesures exhaustives (thermographie infrarouge et images RGB) sur des plateaux de bureaux, logements ou usines d’environ 5 000 m² en une nuit. Cependant, aujourd’hui, le traitement est opéré par un expert sur un nombre restreint de fichiers. La multiplication du nombre de fichiers ne permet pas d’imaginer la mobilisation de l’expert, et seul un traitement automatisé sur la base d’un apprentissage du type Intelligence Artificielle est envisageable.

Le projet THERM_I_BAT vise à concevoir et valider une preuve de concept de diagnostic intelligent des façades de bâtiments, à partir de prises de vues intérieures réalisées par une plateforme robotisée.

Scientifiquement, le projet s’inscrit dans les travaux de recherche et R&D sur l’analyse d’images multimodales et l’apprentissage frugal, en développant de nouveaux modèles d’IA capables de fonctionner avec des jeux de données limités mais fortement contextualisés. Industriellement, il prépare une solution de diagnostic automatisé de la qualité d’enveloppe, compatible avec les outils de la filière (BIM, jumeau numérique) et économiquement acceptable pour un déploiement massif à la réception des bâtiments.

Le planning envisagé est le suivant :

Phase 1 – Acquisition et préparation des données (M1–M12)

• Définition des protocoles de mesure avec CMDL (typologies de bâtiments, scénarios de défauts).

• Réalisation de campagnes de mesures robotisées (IR + RGB) sur plusieurs sites pilotes.

• Constitution d’un jeu de données annoté (défauts, zones saines, contexte BIM).

Phase 2 – Contextualisation spatiale et fusion multimodale (M3–M5)

• Alignement spatial des images IR et RGB, prise en compte de la géométrie des façades.

• Développement de méthodes de fusion multimodale pour produire des représentations conjointes robustes.

Phase 3 – Segmentation sémantique et filtrage des perturbations (M6–M9)

• Développement de modèles de segmentation sémantique pour distinguer les zones pertinentes (parois, menuiseries, éléments techniques) des perturbations (mobilier, objets, reflets).

• Intégration de connaissances expertes CMDL pour guider les classes et les règles de filtrage.

Phase 4 – Détection d’anomalies et classification des défauts (M10–M16)

• Mise en place de modèles de détection d’anomalies thermiques et de classification des défauts (ponts thermiques, défauts d’étanchéité à l’air, artefacts liés aux matériaux).

• Apprentissage frugal à partir de jeux de données limités, complétés éventuellement par des données simulées.

Phase 5 – Génération du diagnostic et validation en environnement pertinent (M16–M18)

• Génération automatique de diagnostics structurés (liste de défauts, typologie, sévérité) et localisation dans le plan/BIM.

• Campagnes de validation sur de nouveaux bâtiments, comparaison avec l’analyse d’experts humains (temps, précision, taux de faux positifs/faux négatifs).

• Consolidation de la preuve de concept (TRL 5) et préparation des suites de valorisation.

Profil recherché / Compétences attendues

Diplômes : Doctorat en Informatique

Connaissances requises : Vision par Ordinateurs, Apprentissage automatique, Apprentissage profond

Compétences opérationnelles : Bonne maîtrise du langage Python et de librairies d’apprentissage profond telles que PyTorch, de l’anglais, et bonnes qualités rédactionnelles et de communication orale

Compétences comportementales : Motivation, rigueur, autonomie, proactivité.

Le processus de recrutement se déroule en deux étapes, supervisé par une commission de recrutement, en conformité avec la politique OTMR de Centrale Lyon.

· Étude du dossier écrit : CV + lettre de motivation + diplôme de doctorat

· Entretien de sélection : en présentiel ou en visioconférence

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. jobs.title: Product Line Manager
jobs.description:
About Wallee Group AG

Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

• 
Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

• 
Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

• 
Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

• 
Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

• 
Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

• 
Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

• 
Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

• 
Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

• 
Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

• 
Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

• 
Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

• 
Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

• 
Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

• 
Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

• 
Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

• 
Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

• 
Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

• 
Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

• 
True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

• 
Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

• 
Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets, and a social calendar filled with events.

• 
The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match.

jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.

Your Impact

• Lead the design, training, and deployment of reinforcement learning policies for robot motion — bridging the gap from simulation to reliable real-world performance

• Provide senior technical guidance on RL and learning-based control across the team, mentoring engineers and establishing best practices for policy development workflows

• Own and evolve the RL training infrastructure and sim-to-real pipeline, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and fast iteration cycles

• Shape the technical vision for internal ML tooling and experiment management (e.g. training dashboards, automated evaluation pipelines), driving efficiency and rigour across the team's learning workflows

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify how to expand the robot's autonomous operational envelope

• Triage field issues related to locomotion, recognise failure patterns, and rapidly improve policy robustness based on real deployment data

• Write, deploy, and maintain efficient Python and C++ software for the learning and locomotion stack

Your Profile

• PhD in robotics, machine learning, computer science or a related field with a strong focus on reinforcement learning; alternatively, an equivalent track record of RL research and deployment in robotics Or

• Master's degree from a top-tier technical university (e.g. ETH Zurich, EPFL) in robotics, machine learning, computer science or related field and 5+ years of professional experience

• Proven track record of shipping ML models to the field and maintaining those solutions over time

• Solid grounding in robot control fundamentals and autonomous systems, including: motion control, state estimation, path planning and actuation

• Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim

• Strong understanding of sim-to-real transfer, domain randomisation, reward shaping, and policy robustness techniques

• Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch); working knowledge of C++

• Strong knowledge of Linux systems and middleware frameworks for integrating learned components into a larger software stack

• Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset — comfortable balancing research exploration with production delivery

• Excellent communication skills in English

Bonus Points

• Experience training and deploying RL policies on physical robots — not just in simulation

• Development of scalable and modular robot architectures of motion control systems

• Experience with navigation systems and autonomous mobile robot operation in unstructured environments

• Interest in agentic engineering toolchains

• Experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices

• A solid grasp of physical systems, specifically multibody dynamics, electromechanical drive physics, energy optimization, and contact physics, to ensure learned policies respect hardware limits and transfer successfully from simulation to the real world

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

• 
Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

• 
Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

• 
User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

• 
Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

•

User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items.

Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated.

Je bouwt mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons platform en vertaalt behoeften vanuit onze klantenteams naar concrete, herbruikbare oplossingen. Je werkt aan features vanuit de roadmap, maar signaleert ook zelf waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.

jobs.title: Senior MLOps Engineer, Buyer
jobs.description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer domain's Data Science teams build and iterate on our most critical ML systems—like ranking, retrieval, and recommendations—that serve millions of users. As our ambition and the complexity of these models grow, we are scaling our MLOps capabilities to match: 

We are hiring an MLOps Engineer to solve this. This is a high-impact "bridge" role, not to build new platforms, but to be the expert user of our existing platforms (GCP/Vertex AI, Vespa, Triton). Your mission is to take our Data Science team's work, rectify the current ad-hoc solutions, and build the robust, automated, and high-quality "path-to-production" our advanced models require.

Also by joining Vinted, you’ll become part of an active community of engineers who are keen on sharing knowledge, organizing learning workshops and so much more!

In this position, you’ll 

  • Productionise ML models: be responsible for migrating all existing model training code from experimental or proof-of-concept stages to robust and automated pipelines.
  • Build continuous training (CT) pipelines: design, build, and maintain automated workflows for data preparation, model training, and batch scoring.
  • Automate model serving & integration: package and deploy traditional ML models (e.g., in ONNX format) to our existing serving infrastructure, primarily Vespa and/or Triton.
  • Close the deployment loop: automate model deployments where they are still manual. For example, building a GitHub Action that deploys a new model to Vespa, triggered by a webhook from a successful Vertex AI training pipeline.
  • Build the missing quality gates: build the automated quality and evaluation gates that our pipelines lack today. This includes:
  • Establish and uphold ML Model Lifecycle Standards: Take ownership of and continuously improve the standards, quality, and governance of the complete ML model lifecycle.

About you 

  • We are looking for an "ML-literate" Software Engineer, not a Data Scientist. You are a builder and an automator with a strong service mindset.
  • Must-have technical skills: deep expertise in GCP/Vertex AI (or equivalents like SageMaker), Kubernetes, and Docker.
  • Automation expertise: proven experience building robust CI/CD and automation pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).
  • ML-Literate: you understand ML workflows and concepts (training, evaluation, inference) well enough to debug pipelines and build meaningful quality gates.
  • Soft skills: a strong "service mindset," excellent communication, and the ability to act as a bridge between the highly technical worlds of Data Science and Infrastructure. You are pragmatic and driven to get high-quality work into production.
  • Bonus Points: familiarity with ML serving platforms like Vespa search engine or NVIDIA Triton and model formats like ONNX.
  • Willingness to learn and master new technologies and concepts.
  • We value pragmatism, big-picture thinking, curiosity, and problem-solving skills.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • A daily lunch allowance
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • An NS mobility card
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

What we value

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:

Drive and Lead

You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn

The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care

We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

Speed and Change

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment.

The Role 

As a Full Stack Developer in the Onboarding & Enablement team, you'll own the front door of CM.com connectivity: the self service experience where customers sign up and start messaging in minutes, without a sales call or a single email. It is one of the most important topics at CM.com today, and your team is the conductor behind it.

In today's tech market, speed wins. Customers choose the provider they can start with right now, and they value ease over a long list of requirements. Think of how quickly you can take out a phone subscription: that is the experience we want to offer. Our customers are people, but increasingly also AI agents, and neither wants to wait for a callback.

Behind that one simple interface sits a complex platform. Every channel works differently. For example: WhatsApp runs via Meta, RCS via Google and Orange, and more channels and suppliers are joining. Customers should never notice any of that. The complexity is ours, not theirs.

You will

• 
Build the self service onboarding experience that takes customers from sign up to their first message in minutes

• 
Turn every customer request into the right configuration across our own systems and external suppliers, fully automated

• 
Make it easy to plug in new channels and supplier partnerships, so the platform grows without adding complexity for the customer

• 
Drive automation across the full customer journey, for people and AI agents alike

• 
Own your work from idea to production, including how it runs on our infrastructure

• 
Use AI tools actively to improve your own work: experiment, automate, and share what works with your team

• 
Medior to senior full stack developer with hands on experience in both front end and back end

• 
Strong in Angular on the front end, and in C# and .NET on the back end

• 
Solid knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL

• 
Fluent in English and Dutch

• 
Nice to have: experience with DevOps or system engineering, as the team also manages its own infrastructure

• 
Genuinely curious about AI: you experiment with tools like ChatGPT or Copilot and you're open to working differently as they improve

Believe you’d be a great fit for this role, even if you don’t tick every box? Reach out to our Recruitment team! We’d be happy to connect and see if we can make it work together.

What we offer

As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:

• 
Onboarding: Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.

• 
Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.

• 
Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well.

• 
Invest in your future: A solid pension plan.

• 
Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.

• 
Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.

• 
Your Development: We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving

• 
Vitality: Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.

• 
Together at CM.com: Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Before you apply

We work on-site, move fast, and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you.

Note: For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the Netherlands.

jobs.title: Mission Critical Security Engineer – Threat Hunting
jobs.description:
Help protect what truly matters in our customers' most critical environments by proactively identifying threats and improving how they are detected and addressed.

As a Mission Critical Security Engineer with a focus on Threat Hunting, you will be part of a dedicated customer team responsible for securing and continuously improving a complex, mission-critical application landscape.

Working alongside other engineers and security specialists, you will help ensure the environment remains as secure and resilient as possible. You combine a strong engineering foundation with a security mindset, taking ownership of security improvements and understanding how systems, applications, and infrastructure behave.

Your specific focus will be on threat hunting and detection engineering. Using your in-depth knowledge of the customer's technology stack and application landscape, you will fine-tune existing detection use cases and develop new ones tailored to the environment. You will use our custom SIEM/SOAR-based Managed Detection and Response (MDR) platform to turn emerging threats and technical insights into actionable detection capabilities.

This role bridges security engineering, detection engineering, and threat intelligence. You don't simply follow predefined playbooks. You understand system behavior, identify gaps, and develop practical solutions that strengthen the security of the customer's environment.

/ What you will do

Threat intelligence & continuous improvement

  • Actively follow security developments, vulnerabilities, and threat intelligence and translate these into relevant hunts and detections.

  • Identify security risks and gaps in detection coverage and proactively propose improvements.

  • Use your knowledge of the customer's application and infrastructure landscape to continuously strengthen its security posture.

  • Contribute to the evolution of the team's security monitoring and detection strategy.

Communication & advisory

  • Translate findings into clear, actionable communication for engineers, customer stakeholders, and security specialists.

  • Contribute to security advisories and share relevant threats across the customer team and wider organization.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand system behavior and validate detection strategies.

  • Collaborate with the customer's Security Operations Center (SOC) to align security monitoring, threat detection, and response activities.

  • Help establish and improve integrations with the customer's SIEM/SOAR platform, including the forwarding of relevant logs and security telemetry.

Detection engineering & threat hunting

  • Develop and continuously improve detection use cases based on emerging threats and observed behavior.

  • Translate threat scenarios and security insights into actionable detection logic tailored to the customer's environment.

  • Proactively perform threat hunting across the application and infrastructure landscape to identify abnormal or suspicious patterns.

  • Analyze logs and telemetry data to uncover behaviors that are not yet covered by existing detections.

  • Use your understanding of the customer's technology stack to distinguish normal from potentially malicious behavior.

Use case development & response design

  • Define what should happen when detections trigger, including response actions, automation, and escalation paths.

  • Continuously refine detection logic to improve quality, relevance, and signal-to-noise ratio.

  • Build and fine-tune custom detection scenarios based on the specific characteristics and security requirements of the customer's environment.

Platform collaboration

  • Leverage our custom SIEM/SOAR-based MDR platform to implement detections and analyze data.

  • Collaborate with platform and automation engineers to improve integrations and detection capabilities.

  • Apply engineering and automation practices to ensure detection solutions are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

/ What you bring

We are looking for someone who combines solid engineering fundamentals with a strong interest in security and is motivated to move towards or deepen their expertise in threat hunting and detection engineering.

You don't necessarily need to be an experienced threat hunter already. What matters is your ability to understand complex systems, recognize unusual behavior, and translate technical insights into practical security improvements.

Must-have skills

  • Solid engineering fundamentals, including Linux, networking, and infrastructure behavior.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or similar platforms.

  • Experience with CI/CD, Git, and configuration management or infrastructure-as-code tooling.

  • Strong automation mindset and the ability to translate problems into scalable solutions.

  • Experience working with logs and telemetry to analyze system behavior and investigate technical issues.

  • Experience with Python and/or Bash scripting.

  • Familiarity with SIEM or log analytics platforms such as OpenSearch, Elastic, Splunk, or Microsoft Sentinel.

  • Strong understanding of security principles, including threat detection and response.

  • Ability to distinguish normal from abnormal system behavior.

  • Analytical, curious, and driven to understand how systems and threats behave.

  • Ownership mindset, with responsibility for security quality and continuous improvement.

  • Strong communication skills to translate technical findings into actionable insights.

  • Ability to connect business and customer context to technical security solutions.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Hands-on experience with threat hunting, detection engineering, or advanced SOC operations.

  • Experience developing or improving detection use cases and security monitoring rules.

  • Experience with SOAR or security automation.

  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, and other Microsoft cloud services.

  • Familiarity with threat intelligence frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Experience integrating SIEM/SOAR platforms or forwarding security telemetry between different environments.

/ Who are you?

As Junior Product Manager for IT Fulfillment, you will help build and improve the services that make that happen: the order flows, data and interfaces that connect our webstore, our stores, our warehouses and our customer service teams.
You will work in a small team inside the IT Fulfillment domain, alongside the Group Product Manager and our own engineers. The Group Product Manager shapes the functional direction with the business and sets priorities; together you turn it into clear requirements, well-defined tickets and working software, built with engineers and AI agents. This is a technical product role: we build our own services, so you will spend your time in data models, interfaces and requirements rather than managing a vendor’s roadmap. You start close to delivery, with support while you learn the domain, and grow into owning more of the roadmap.
What you will do
  • Turn mapped-out functional flows into clear, buildable work: technical requirements, acceptance criteria and user stories that engineers and AI agents can pick up without coming back with questions.
  • Own the detail as both product manager and business analyst: the data model, the way systems talk to each other, and the edge cases nobody thought of yet.
  • Break large changes into chunks that can be built, tested and released safely, and keep the backlog in a state where work can start at any moment.
  • Work with engineers day to day in refinement, planning, reviews and releases, and use our AI tooling to draft, structure and pressure-test the work before it reaches them.
  • Design our order data and interfaces so that AI agents can read, reason over and act on them as reliably as our own systems do.

jobs.description:
About Finom

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

Senior Specialist, T2 (Target2) Payment Operations 

Location: Remote in Netherlands, Spain, Cyprus or Poland

The role

We’re moving from indirect to direct participation in TARGET2 (T2), and we need someone to own the operational side end to end. You’ll design and document the Payment Operations processes, validate them in the August UAT, cut over BIC by BIC, and then run them as business-as-usual. You’ll be the operational contact for the T2 scheme, DNB and our partner banks.

What you’ll do

• Own core payment processes: SCT / SCT Inst recalls, investigations (including pacs.028), SWIFT enquiries (MT199/MT999, RFIs), missing or incoming funds, and rejects, returns and refunds.

• Run the T2 platform day to day: work in the T2 GUI (U2A/A2A), maintain CRDM reference data, and set up four-eyes controls and the manual-vs-automated split.

• Manage the migration: move traffic from BNP Paribas to direct participation, with every payment traceable by BIC and path, and define when each BNPP-dependent step can be retired.

• Cover reconciliation and liquidity: be the Payment Ops link to the reconciliation team (funding and defunding stay with Finance Ops/Treasury).

• Handle incidents and contingency: build the incident process around DNB, FIS and TARGET escalation routes, own Payment Ops’ role in DNB reporting, and define the ECONS II contingency approach.

• Coordinate with others: work with the Eurosystem, DNB, SWIFT/NEXI, FIS and correspondent banks, and partner with Product and Engineering to specify how the platform should behave.

What success looks like

• Every direct-participation process has an owner, documented procedures, and passing UAT evidence.

• The migration causes no impact on customers, and Customer Support has clear guidance.

• After go-live, T2 runs as stable BAU with no remaining BNPP operational dependency.

What we’re looking for

• Hands-on experience with T2 / TARGET Services (RTGS, TIPS), including the GUI and U2A/A2A actions

• Around 2-3+ years in payment operations at a bank, EMI or PSP, ideally with SEPA schemes (SCT, SCT Inst)

• Familiarity with investigations, recalls, returns and SWIFT / ISO 20022 messaging

• Experience writing SOPs and controls, or the ability to pick it up quickly

• Comfort working with regulators, partners and technical teams

• Enough ownership to make sign-off and escalation decisions with support from the team

• Fluent English

Nice to have

• Experience with CRDM reference-data maintenance

• Involvement in a direct-participation onboarding or sponsor-bank migration

• Knowledge of DNB / TARGET-NL conditions, IPR, PSD2, or ECONS II contingency processes

Make a genuine impact on the product

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

Work in the EU

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

jobs.title: Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What is Anori Tech doing?

The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work.

As battery applications multiply, from robotics and mobility to data centers and grid-scale storage, BMS complexity is exploding. Legacy BMS architectures were never built for this: too rigid to keep up with new requirements, they've turned the BMS into the bottleneck of battery development.

We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry.

We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years.

Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market.

Our Motivation

At Anori Tech, we believe everything is energy, and progress runs on it. With Anori we actively shape the energy transition: from oil to electric, from low to high efficiency. We need batteries for this transition and almost all batteries need a BMS. We strive for Shenzhen speed and German engineering quality. Our objective: put Europe back on the map in the race for the energy transition and build technical leadership out of Hamburg.

About the Role

A BMS is only as good as what it knows about the battery. As our Algorithm Engineer, you'll develop the algorithms that tell the Anori BMS what is happening inside the cells: state of charge, state of health and balancing. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. Later on, the role grows into the cloud, where data pipelines and fleet analytics will build on the models you create today. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware and hardware engineers.

Start date: from January 1, 2027

What You'll Do

• 
Develop the algorithms that estimate SoC and SoH for different cell chemistries and applications

• 
Design balancing strategies that fit the hardware and use case

• 
Build battery models (e.g. equivalent circuit models) and parameterize them from measurement data with statistical rigor

• 
Implement your algorithms directly in the embedded Rust firmware, efficient enough for constrained hardware

• 
Design experiments and evaluation methodologies: analyze failure modes, quantify trade-offs between accuracy, robustness and compute cost

• 
Support in building data pipelines and fleet analytics in the cloud

What You Bring

Must have

• 
Hands-on experience with state of charge and state of health estimation, shown in a product, publication or substantial project. For example Kalman-type filters, H∞ filters, observers, or coulomb counting with model-based correction

• 
Deep understanding of battery behavior and modeling, e.g. equivalent circuit models, hysterisis, ageing or also physics based models

• 
Experience implementing numerical algorithms on embedded, constrained hardware (e.g. in Rust or C/C++ - heads-up our firmware is written in Rust, and we'll help you get up to speed)

• 
Strong Python skills for modeling, simulation and data analysis

• 
Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms

Strongly preferred

• 
Experience with cell balancing algorithms and their effects

• 
Working with real cell data from test benches or cyclers

• 
Signal processing fundamentals: FIR/IIR filter design, sampling and aliasing, noise characterization of sensor data

Nice to have

• 
Data pipelines, fleet analytics or cloud experience

• 
Machine learning methods for battery data, for example data-driven state of health estimation or anomaly detection

• 
Model-based systems engineering and requirements engineering (the skills, not the paper)

You don't tick every box? Apply anyway. No one matches a job description 100%. If this role excites you and you are motivated to grow yourself into it, we want to hear from you.

What We Offer

• 
Work on a product with purpose that redefines the state of art: our product is a key part to enable competitive battery energy storage.

• 
Work directly with the founding team on decisions that shape the company. The team is small, so your ideas will matter. A lot.

• 
Challenging engineering in an industrial, but research-near environment. We bring research into the industry.

• 
A modern stack and methods: Rust, MBSE, everything as code, and the best tools and techniques for the job, chosen on merit.

• 
To be both supported and challenged: room to grow, and the expectation that you will.

You might be a fit if

• 
You hold yourself to a high standard and don’t settle for "good enough."

• 
You want to have a big say in what the Anori BMS looks like and how it works

• 
You are eager to try out new tools and enjoy incorporating AI into your work to make your life easier and more productive

• 
You are excited about startups and all the opportunities and uncertainties that come with it

• 
You want to be an active part in accelerating the energy transition in Europe

• 
You are comfortable with English as a working language

• 
You are happy to be in the office most of the time because for fast decisions we need to be in the same room. We expect you to be in the office at least 3 days / week

Interview Process

• 
First Call A short chat with one of our founders. We'll get to know your background and answer any questions you have about Anori Tech. 30 min

• 
Deep Dive with Case Study (on-site) A meeting with Stefan, our CTO. We want to understand how you work and talk through your past projects. The meeting also includes a small case study, and we will send you some context information for it beforehand. 2 - 3 hours

• 
Meet the Team (on-site) Time to meet your future colleagues! In this meeting we get to know each other. This is also the time to discuss final details like salary. 1 - 2 hours

The on-site meetings will be at our lab at the Bahrenfeld Startup Lab: Luruper Hauptstraße 1, 22547 Altona

You also want to become an Anori? We cannot wait to meet you. Go and click the apply button. Don’t be shy, we are nice.

ChillQuanta is developing an electro-optic spectrometer for inspecting and characterizing photonic qubits (semiconductor quantum-dot single- and entangled-photon sources), aiming to replace or combine today's separate methods (capacitance-voltage, photoluminescence, resonance fluorescence spectroscopy) with one new sub-100-femtosecond-resolution, non-destructive electro-optic technique — with a patent filing already in progress. Founded by Amar Alok (CEO, PhD in Experimental Physics from RUB, 4+ years in ultrafast optics and pump-probe spectroscopy) alongside a Chemistry postdoc, ChillQuanta has a lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, an Invention Disclosure accepted by RUB (April 2026) with a manuscript in preparation for Physical Review Letters, and over €12k raised so far. The next step is turning the lab prototype into an automated instrument and deciding between licensing and starting a company — which is where a business co-founder comes in. ChillQuanta is separately also open to an AI/ML co-founder to help build wafer-scale AI prediction capability.

Tasks

What you will own

Company build-up & strategy

Commercialization
- Turn the lab prototype (TRL 3-4) into an automated, sellable instrument in partnership with the technical team.

Business operations
- Establish the commercial and operational foundation (pricing, business model, partnerships) the founding science team doesn't yet have.

Requirements

Core experience
- Business development or MBA-level commercial experience, ideally with deep-tech, scientific instrumentation, or semiconductor/quantum industry exposure.
- Comfort making a licensing-vs-startup call and building a go-to-market plan from a lab-stage prototype.

Especially valuable
- Existing network in quantum technology, semiconductor metrology, or scientific instrumentation.
- Fundraising experience for deep-tech ventures (grants and/or investors).
- ChillQuanta is separately seeking an AI/ML co-founder to build wafer-scale AI prediction — relevant ML/software experience is valuable for that parallel track.

Benefits

Why join ChillQuanta
- A validated lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, with an Invention Disclosure already accepted by RUB and a manuscript heading to Physical Review Letters.
- A genuinely novel technique (patent filing in progress) addressing a real gap in photonic-qubit inspection for the fast-growing quantum and semiconductor chip markets.
- Ground-floor business co-founder equity alongside a strong physics/chemistry founding team.

jobs.title: SAP Koordinator (m/w/d) – Schnittstellen, Berechtigungen & Dienstleistersteuerung
jobs.description:
Sie kennen SAP aus dem laufenden Betrieb, bis in Tabellen, Logs und Transporte?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit stabilen Systemen tragen.

Warum diese Rolle?

Das SAP-System läuft auf ECC 6.0, ist über Jahre gewachsen und soll auf S/4HANA umgestellt werden. Die Basis betreibt ein externer Dienstleister, in den Fachbereichen entsteht ein Key-User-Konzept. Gesucht wird die Person, die das Ganze technisch zusammenhält.

• Weil Sie die Verantwortung für ein SAP-Backend tragen, das zuverlässig läuft.

• Weil Sie den Weg von ECC zu S/4HANA von Anfang an begleiten.

• Weil Sie Zuständigkeiten klären und Strukturen schaffen, die bleiben.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie behalten Hintergrundjobs, IDoc-Verarbeitung, RFC-Verbindungen, EDI-Strecken und angebundene Drittsysteme im Blick. Fehler analysieren Sie über Dumps, Logs und Traces und verfolgen sie bis zur Lösung.

• Sie koordinieren den Basis-Dienstleister bei Upgrades, Patches und Performance-Themen, später auch beim Wechsel auf S/4HANA, und fordern Ergebnisse ein.

• Sie prüfen Anforderungen und legen fest, ob Sie selbst umsetzen, den Dienstleister beauftragen oder die Aufgabe an den Fachbereich geben.

• Sie unterstützen die Fachbereiche beim Aufbau ihrer Key-User-Rollen.

• Sie erledigen selbst Benutzer und Rollen, SAPscript- und Smartforms-Anpassungen, Jobeinplanung, Systemnachrichten und kleinere technische Änderungen.

• Sie halten Systemlandschaft und Abläufe schriftlich fest, sodass Wissen im Unternehmen bleibt.

Zur Einordnung: Installation, Datenbank und Betriebssystem verantwortet der Basis-Dienstleister. Sie steuern ihn und sind die Ansprechperson für alles im SAP-Umfeld, wofür es noch keine klare Zuständigkeit gibt.

Das bringen Sie mit

• Eine IT-nahe oder kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium

• Mehrere Jahre SAP-Erfahrung im Inhouse-Betrieb eines Unternehmens, idealerweise mit ECC 6.0

• Technischen Tiefgang: Sie lesen Dumps und Traces, kennen Jobs, Transporte und Tabellen und sprechen mit dem Basis-Dienstleister auf Augenhöhe

• Praxis mit IDocs, RFC und EDI sowie mit Rollen und Berechtigungen (PFCG, SU53)

• Erfahrung in Projekten und in der Steuerung externer Partner, dazu Ausdauer beim Nachhaken

• Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch

• Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Middleware und erste Berührungspunkte mit S/4HANA

Das erwartet Sie

• Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing und Weiterbildung

Interesse?

Wenn Sie sich in dieser Rolle wiederfinden, senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin.

Most labs still count cells under a microscope by hand. It's slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're replacing that manual work with software. By combining a standard microscope with a smartphone, we run computer vision models that locate, track, and measure cells automatically in real time. We're starting with semen analysis and expanding to other routine microscopic samples. We're a small, well-funded team in Berlin, founded in 2026. Our goal is to make automated, reliable diagnostic analysis accessible on any phone connected to a microscope.

The role

We're looking for an engineer who wants to own the whole platform behind a medical product: services, data, infrastructure, security and identity. A first version runs today. The hard part is making it trustworthy enough for clinical use: patient data that stays safe, an audit trail that holds up for years, and a system that recovers when something breaks. You'll own all of it, working closely with the founders and our CTO.

What you'll do

• 
Own the platform end to end: backend, data, infrastructure and security.

• 
Get it ready for clinical use, and keep it reliable as we grow.

• 
Build identity, access and data handling that clinics and auditors can trust.

• 
Make the architecture calls: what to build now, what to defer, what to cut.

• 
Set the engineering standard and help hire the team that follows.

What you bring

• 
Platforms you've built and run. You've built backend platforms from scratch and run them in production, through outages, data incidents, migrations and growth.

• 
Database depth. You know what happens under the query: indexing, locking, transactions, replication, zero-downtime schema changes, and backups you've actually restored.

• 
Security by default. Authentication and authorisation, tenant isolation, secrets, audit logging. You think about how a system gets attacked before it ships.

• 
Identity done properly. Identity providers, sessions and tokens, roles and permissions, onboarding and offboarding.

Infrastructure. Infrastructure as code, containers, Linux, networking and cloud are everyday tools for you.

Beyond the backend. The backend is your home, but when the product needs it, you read and change the app yourself.

Systematic troubleshooting. You reproduce first and fix root causes. You work from evidence like logs, traces, metrics and query plans, and you stay calm when production breaks.

AI-native engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You give them good context, split work into reviewable steps, and stand behind every line you ship.

Ownership. You help shape the roadmap, push back on weak ideas, set your own priorities and raise problems early. Nobody has to chase you. Strong opinions, held with evidence and open to revision.

Serving ML models in production.
