Job Overview:
We are seeking a Manufacturing Test Engineer to join Anduril, working in a cutting-edge start-up environment to advance the state-of-the-possible in subsea robotics. The Manufacturing Test Engineer will be charged with developing and implementing high-fidelity, automated test processes on both the component and system level. Working closely with engineering staff and a team of skilled electro-mechanical technicians, this role is key to advancing our testing capabilities to ensure the highest levels quality are achieved as we continue drive scalability into our production operations.

About the Team
Anduril’s Manufacturing team is producing the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles globally at rate. The Manufacturing Engineering team owns production readiness and process engineering across the Undersea Dominance product range — from core vehicle platform to specialised mission payloads, spanning mechanical and electrical hardware build through to full system integration & test.

About the Job
You will own the test software, automation and tooling that proves every Dive-XL vehicle works before it leaves the building — the Python frameworks that drive instruments and vehicle hardware, the operator-facing GUIs that make complex test sequences safe and repeatable under production pressure, and the interlocks that protect people and product when the system is commanding real high-voltage DC. You will also own the infrastructure underneath: NixOS-based station builds, test result flow into MES, and the configuration management that keeps a fleet of test stations reproducible and rollback-safe. If you thrive hands-on — oscilloscopes and protocol analysers as often as a code editor — in a fast-paced environment where the architecture is yours to build, this role is for you.


What You'll Do

  • Build a broad range of test capabilities across the manufacturing value stream - PCBA bring up, electrical boxes/bottles bring-up, system level checkouts and acceptance testing to key component level in process validation.
  • Develop, execute, and manage test eco-system to de-risk hardware and ensure product meets target reliability levels and ultimate design intent.
  • Perform hands-on and data-driven root cause analysis of electromechanical subsystems utilizing structured problem solving methodologies.
  • Design, implement and maintain semi-automated testing equipment/protocols for subsystem characterization and testing.
  • Diagnose production test issues hands-on as fist point of contact for test technicians. Isolate the failure mode, work with Electrical Design and Software when escalation is needed.
  • Collaborate with the design/systems team throughout product development cycles to perform risk assessments, maintain ownership of test deployment activities in production, oversee technician training, burn down bug fixes/improvements as needed.
  • Produce and maintain testing logs/data, develop library of error codes with troubleshooting logic/diagrams for fast issue resolution.
  • Generate controlled test instructions that can be easily followed by technician team in MES or other test execution systems.
  • Optimize test design and execution of full system “end of line” factory acceptance test (FAT) of AUVs
  • Design and execution of PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary


REQUIRED QUALIFIACTIONS

  • Degree in Software, Computer, Electrical, Mechatronic or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • Experience in hardware testing and automated test systems (LabVIEW, Test Stand, etc.)
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Matlab, SHELL, or others
  • Experience with computer hardware communication protocols: USB, Ethernet, RS232, RS485, PCIe, HDMI, CAN, etc
  • 3+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably test design of electro-mechanical hardware in a manufacturing environment
  • Are well versed with complex electromechanical systems and are passionate about understanding what it takes to make them work reliably
  • Have experience developing full system test plans and know how to execute them on fast-paced product development timelines
  • Have experience with programming/testing a wide range of sensors, actuators, and electrical components
  • Can prototype and run your own tests, from experimental setup to hardware and software implementation
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government NV2 Security Clearance (Australian citizen).


PREFERRED QUALIFIACTIONS

  • Experience in sub-sea robotics or AUV/UUV industries
  • Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Test Execution Systems (TES)
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new skills or adapt to new situations. Un-phased by challenges that go beyond the traditional comfort zone or work experience. Multidisciplinary approach to problem solving
  • Comfortable with high project ownership under technical and schedule pressure, particularly where the scope and definition are limited
  • Experience testing and operating with or around hazardous systems (high voltage up to 400V)
  • Experience working on projects that involve the integration of electrical, mechanical, and software/firmware systems
  • Experience with NixOS, or anydeclarative-configuration background (Ansible, Puppet, Chef).
  • Test frameworks — pytest-based harnesses, LabVIEW, TestStand or equivalent. Exposure to more than one is a plus.

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. jobs.title: AI Ops Engineer (Business Operations)
jobs.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY.

The Role

We’re looking for an AI Ops Engineer to build the internal systems that help Kernel scale without adding unnecessary manual work. You’ll work across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations - finding the highest-leverage problems and building practical AI-powered workflows.

This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll take ideas from a vague business problem to a tool or workflow that people use, then maintain and improve it in production. You’ll choose the fastest sensible approach for each problem - coding agents, automation platforms, APIs, data pipelines or lightweight code.

You’ll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations, and partner closely with GTM, Marketing, and Customer Success leadership.

What You’ll Be Doing

• 
Define how an AI-native company operates: help build Kernel’s internal playbook for using AI across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations

• 
Make our GTM team more productive: automate the repetitive work in prospecting, account research, meeting prep and CRM hygiene, so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers

• 
Build internal tools and workflows: use coding agents, APIs, automation platforms, no-code tools or lightweight code

• 
Turn company data into operational leverage: connect and improve data across our systems, then put it to work in AI agents, proactive workflows and better decision-making

• 
Put AI agents to work across Kernel: give teams agents with the right context, tools and guardrails so they can move faster without sacrificing judgement or reliability

• 
Be Kernel’s own internal customer: deploy Kernel on Kernel’s CRM, improve our GTM data and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

• 
Level up the team: help colleagues become confident AI users, document what works and turn successful experiments into repeatable ways of working

Your First 6 Months

For your first six months, you’ll focus on our sales team. You’ll sit with our BDRs, AEs and Account Managers and learn how they work day to day. Then you’ll automate everything that doesn’t need a human. That means going deep on Salesforce and our GTM stack, and owning the RevOps workflows behind them. After that, you’ll bring the same approach to Marketing, Customer Success and Operations.

What You Bring

•

About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

jobs.title: Ingénieur.e de recherche : Analyse de la chaine d'epuration de syngaz (H/F) - CDD 18 mois
jobs.description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables.

GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets.

Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires.

Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source.

Les principales tâches que le candidat retenu devra prendre en charge sont :

· La réalisation d’un état de l’art des différentes briques technologies de traitement et d’épuration de biogaz, ainsi que des différentes chaînes existantes dans la littérature.

· Une meilleure appréhension de l’impact de la composition des gisements sur la qualité du gaz en sortie du gazéifieur et l’impact de celui-ci sur la chaine d’épuration.

· L’identification des verrous techniques, des incertitudes et des lacunes de connaissances limitant la maîtrise des différentes briques technologiques.

· Une proposition de modèles des chaines d’épuration (simulation 0D) afin d’établir les bilans de matières et d’énergie et d’estimer la performance globale du procédé.

· L’identification de critères permettant de guider les choix de construction d’une chaîne d’opérations.

· La participation aux réunions de suivi du projet et la rédaction des comptes-rendus de réunion.

· La rédaction de rapports du projet en français et des publications scientifiques en anglais et la création de supports de présentation.

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES :

Ce poste nécessite des compétences en génie des procédés, procédés thermiques, thermodynamique et modélisation de procédés. Le candidat doit avoir une expérience dans la modélisation 0D des procédés. La connaissance et la pratique d’un ou plusieurs logiciels de simulation de procédés libres ou commerciaux sera considéré un plus.

Le candidat doit faire preuve rigueur, être doté d’un bon sens de l’analyse et savoir travailler en autonomie au sein d’une équipe. Les qualités d’analyse bibliographique et rédactionnelles sont un point essentiel pour ce poste.

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

· Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

· cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha

· 49 jours de congés par an

· restauration administrative sur place

· aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail

· action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles)

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :

•

•

jobs.description:

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an Account Manager, Client Development & Renewals, you will own a book of existing customer accounts and drive both renewal retention and expansion revenue within them. This is a growth-first role where renewal is the floor, not the goal: you will protect the base by keeping renewals healthy and on time, and grow it by uncovering whitespace, running consultative upsell and cross-sell conversations, and turning satisfied customers into expanding ones. Working closely with Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and Sales Engineers, you will build account plans and get ahead of risk before it reaches the forecast. If you are driven to outgrow a base you know well, own your numbers, and earn a path to strategic accounts or AE-track roles through expansion results, this role is for you.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own a portfolio of existing accounts carrying a dual quota of renewal retention and expansion bookings, identifying whitespace across the SentinelOne portfolio and leading consultative upsell and cross-sell conversations built around customer use cases and outcomes rather than just quotes.
  • Spot expansion triggers early, such as new use cases, organizational growth, underutilized licenses, and competitive displacement openings, and build repeatable account plans with your CSM and SE partners that map multi-year growth rather than just the next renewal.
  • Manage renewals end to end, from early quoting and multi-threading through negotiation and on-time close, handling commercial negotiations including multi-year commitments and keeping timelines definitive and forecasts predictable across your book.
  • Identify churn and downgrade risk early by monitoring deployment health, usage, support signals, and sentiment, running save motions on at-risk accounts with CSM, Support, and leadership, and getting ahead of overdeployment and downgrade exposure before it hits the renewal.
  • Own an accurate, transparent forecast across renewal and expansion pipeline, keep Salesforce and CPQ tools current, and partner with CSMs, AEs, SEs, and Channel/MSSP partners on account coverage and growth while bringing the customer’s voice back to Product and the broader team.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 3–5 years in renewals, account management, or a customer-facing sales role with upsell and cross-sell closing experience, ideally in SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • A track record of hitting or beating quota, including driving net revenue retention above 100% on your own book, with expansion outpacing churn rather than renewal completion alone.
  • Proven experience running consultative upsell and cross-sell motions, identifying and closing whitespace within an existing customer base, and negotiating confidently with senior and economic buyers across multi-stakeholder conversations.
  • A risk-aware instinct for spotting early signals of churn or downgrade, combined with strong forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, and hands-on experience with Salesforce and CPQ or quoting tools.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, curiosity about customer use cases and the product, and a habit of opening expansion conversations unprompted, with comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Exposure to Channel/MSSP or 2-tier GTM models is a plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. .

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
80-100% | as soon as possible | Germany or Switzerland

About Exeon

Exeon is a Swiss cyber security company based in Zurich. Since 2016, we have been protecting critical infrastructures, financial institutions and enterprises whose operations fully rely on IT through AI-powered analysis of network communication. This makes the most sophisticated cyberattacks visible – attacks conventional tools fail to detect. We combine Swiss excellence with a flexible, remote-first, and collaborative culture, supporting passionate, ambitious professionals devoted to solving cybersecurity challenges and driving continuous innovation.

What your impact will be like:

As a Systems Engineer in our Solutions team, you will help design the components and data flow of our core products: how data gets in, how deployments are configured and operated, and how everything scales across very different customer environments, many of them on-prem and air-gapped. 

You’ll split your time between building (ingestion pipelines, automation, tooling) and deploying and operating (working with customers to get Exeon running reliably in their environments), so your work shapes both scalability and customer success.

In particular, you will:

• 
Build tooling and automation to simplify the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Exeon.NDR, Exeon.UEBA, log collection and supporting components 

• 
Design, build, and maintain scalable log ingestion pipelines for a wide range of network and application log sources and formats, including parsing, normalization, and validation 

• 
Deploy and operate Exeon in customer environments (on-prem, private cloud, and hybrid), including sizing, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex issues 

• 
Work with customers to understand their data sources, infrastructure constraints, and security needs, and translate these into clear requirements for product and engineering teams 

• 
Contribute to customer support, documentation, and runbooks alongside your Solutions colleagues

What you can expect from us:

Exeon offers an open company culture that values and encourages diversity, teamwork and a growth mindset. Our goal is to provide our employees with an exciting, supportive and motivating environment for personal growth and career development while ensuring that our team maintains a healthy work-life balance. We strive to achieve this by offering:

• 
An exciting and impactful job in a fast-growing Swiss cyber tech company expanding across Europe with manifold opportunities to shape your professional profile.

• 
Working in close collaboration with our interdisciplinary team and learning from our Security Experts, Data Scientists, and Business Professionals.

• 
Taking over responsibilities quickly and help shape and promote a cutting-edge security software.

• 
A high degree of trust, independence and flexibility, also in terms of working hours and place of work (remote or in the office).

• 
A competitive salary and appealing benefits package.

What you bring along:

We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated and enthusiastic cyber security professional who is comfortable in a high-paced start-up environment and who shares our values. You should be confident with solving problems independently and communicating easily with both internal teams and directly with customers. You should also:

• 
3-5 years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, platform/infrastructure engineering, or a similar role 

• 
Working knowledge of network and application security and the telemetry relevant to detection 

• 
UNIX/Linux experience, including networking, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in containerized deployments (Docker and/or Kubernetes) 

• 
Strong programming skills in Python and Bash (or comparable languages), with a focus on automation and maintainable, production-quality code 

• 
Hands-on experience designing and operating data ingestion pipelines (e.g. syslog, Logstash/Fluentd/Vector, Elastic stack, or similar), including handling heterogeneous formats and high volumes 

• 
Comfortable with working in a largely remote team where clear communication is key to successful collaboration and impact. We are an English-speaking team but German fluency is appreciated when communicating to some customers 

• 
Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have:

• 
Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals, common attack patterns, and the log and telemetry sources that matter for detection 

• 
Experience with SIEM, SOAR, or detection platforms (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Security), or as a detection engineer or security analyst 

• 
Familiarity with network telemetry such as NetFlow/IPFIX, Zeek, or Suricata, and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK 

• 
Prior customer-facing or professional services experience.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. 

Lead what comes next: With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. 

Our stack:

• 
Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

• 
Frontend: React, TypeScript

• 
Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs

• 
Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB)

• 
DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana

What we are looking for

Required:

• 
Education: MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar.

• 
Python: This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems.

• 
Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. 

• 
Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems.

• 
Cloud & data: You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS.

• 
Leadership attitude: You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader.

• 
Languages: English. German is a big plus.

• 
Hybrid setting: You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products.

• 
Availability: 100%, as soon as possible.

• 
Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position.

Preferred:

• 
Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means.

• 
Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. 

• 
Frontend: React and TypeScript.

Mindset:

• 
Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself.

• 
Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you.

• 
Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter.

Benefits

Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work.

Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company.

Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days.

Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out.

The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one.

Sounds like you?

Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points:

• 
About you: A short description of yourself.

• 
Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences.

• 
Startup: Why do you fit a startup?

• 
Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together.

• 
Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it.

jobs.title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

• 
Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

• 
Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

• 
Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days)

• 
30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

• 
60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

• 
90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities

1. Storytelling That Converts

• 
Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

• 
Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

• 
Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

• 
Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution

• 
Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

• 
Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

• 
Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA

• 
Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

• 
Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

• 
Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

• 
Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops

• 
Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

• 
Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

• 
Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

• 
Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

What We Are Looking For

Essential Experience & Qualifications

• 
3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

• 
Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

• 
Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

• 
Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

• 
Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

• 
CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

Preferred Technical Skills

• 
Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

Mindset & Soft Skills

• 
Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

• 
Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

• 
Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

Working Environment & Expectations

• 
Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

• 
Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win.

• 
Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively.

Why join Papers?

• 
Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means.

• 
High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes.

• 
Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

• 
Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth.

• 
25 days paid vacation per year.

jobs.title: Technical Support Consultant
jobs.description:
Print & Copy Channel Business Unit

Locatie:

Deze hybride functie biedt de flexibiliteit om zowel vanuit ons kantoor in Almere als vanuit huis te werken.

Contract:

Het betreft een functie voor onbepaalde tijd, onder voorbehoud van de toepasselijke lokale arbeidswetgeving op basis van de standplaats van de kandidaat.

Rapporteert aan:

Cluster Manager (Primair & Commercieel) en IT Manager (Technisch & functioneel)

Scope:

Ondersteuning voor Single cluster (BnNe-regio)

Over ITS

Info Technology Supply Ltd (ITS) is een gerenommeerd softwarebedrijf met meer dan 38 jaar ervaring in de print- en documentmanagementindustrie in Europa en Noord- en Zuid-Amerika. Onze Business Unit Print & Copy Channel distribueert exclusief softwareoplossingen van toonaangevende leveranciers en ondersteunt een uitgebreid netwerk van meer dan 2.000 resellers en partners, verdeeld over zes regionale clusters.

Als het grootste PaperCut Authorised Solution Centre van Europa beschikken wij over een uitgebreid portfolio, waaronder PaperCut MF, NG, Hive en Pocket, evenals Umango, Willow360 en DocSlide. Daarnaast ontwikkelen wij diverse aanvullende modules die onze oplossingen verder versterken en uitbreiden.

Met vestigingen en activiteiten in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Spanje, Nederland, België, Frankrijk, de DACH-regio en Oost-Europa zijn wij een werkelijk internationale organisatie. Tegelijkertijd behouden wij de persoonlijke betrokkenheid, korte lijnen en warme familiecultuur die ons al jarenlang kenmerken.

De Kans

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans om je technische expertise verder te ontwikkelen en onderdeel te worden van het Technical Services Team van een internationaal en innovatief softwarebedrijf.

Als Technical Support Consultant ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van technische ondersteuning en het uitvoeren van implementaties bij klanten binnen de BeNe-regio. Je werkt hybride vanuit ons kantoor in Almere, gecombineerd met thuiswerken.

Voor deze functie zoeken wij een enthousiaste en nauwkeurige professional met een proactieve instelling en een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen. Je bent in staat om klanten hoogwaardige technische ondersteuning te bieden en hen te begeleiden bij de implementatie en het beheer van onze oplossingen voor print-, scan- en documentmanagement.

Je werkt hierbij onder andere met producten uit ons portfolio, waaronder PaperCut, Umango, DocSlide en diverse andere innovatieve softwareoplossingen.

Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden

Customer Support (Klantenondersteuning)

1. Het bieden van technische ondersteuning via de helpdesk, telefonisch, e-mail en via remote sessies en incidenteel onsite bij partners en/of eindklanten.

2. Het installeren en configureren van softwareoplossingen zoals PaperCut MF en Hive, Umango en DocSlide.

3. Het analyseren en oplossen van technische vraagstukken.

4. Het testen en reproduceren van klantproblemen in een virtuele omgeving.

Pre-Sales & Training

• Het geven van technische trainingen, workshops en online technische demonstraties.

• Het ondersteunen van collega's en bijdragen aan interne IT-projecten.

• Het beantwoorden van technische vragen van klanten en partners.

• Het samenwerken met support- en consultancycollega's binnen Europa.

• Het bezoeken van eindklanten in de BeNe-regio om installaties en trainingen ter plaatse uit te voeren.

• Nauwe samenwerking met het Internationale iTS Supportteam.

• Technische en functionele interne Presales-vragen beantwoorden.

• Het creëren en uitvoeren van praktische technische trainingen en workshops voor partners.

Internal IT

1. Assisteren bij technische support aan collega's op zowel de software als de hardware die het bedrijf gebruikt.

2. Ondersteuning van de interne infrastructuur en diensten.

Vereiste kwalificaties

Ervaring & Achtergrond

• Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van het Nederlands en een goede beheersing van het Engels.

• Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om gemakkelijk een goede relatie op te bouwen met klanten.

• Ervaring met print management oplossingen, zoals "Papercut" of scanoplossingen, is meegenomen.

4. Ervaring met Microsoft Windows Server- en clientplatformen, Active Directory, Entra ID en Microsoft SQL Server.

5. Ervaring met Windows-printservers, printwachtrijen en het uitrollen van printerdrivers is een pré.

6. Gedegen kennis van netwerken (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewallpoorten en SNMP) voor het oplossen van communicatieproblemen tussen servers, clients en printers.

7. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde aanpak van complexe technische vraagstukken.

8. Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om nieuwe technologieën snel en zelfstandig eigen te maken.

9. In staat om zowel zelfstandig als effectief binnen een team te werken.

• Kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.

Pré

• Eerdere ervaring in een functie op het gebied van klantenservice of technische ondersteuning.

• Kennis van PaperCut-functionaliteiten zoals Find-Me Printing, Print Deploy, Mobility Print en scanworkflows (scan-to-email, scan-to-folder en scan-to-cloud).

• Ervaring met het configureren van embedded software en kaartlezers op multifunctionele printers van merken zoals Canon, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Kyocera of HP.

• Ervaring met andere print- en scanmanagementoplossingen, zoals Equitrac, uniFLOW of YSoft SAFEQ.

• Een PaperCut-certificering, bijvoorbeeld PaperCut Certified Engineer.

• Ervaring met virtualisatieplatformen en Microsoft Azure.

• Bekendheid met macOS en Linux.

Wat wij aanbieden

Wij geloven dat plezier in je werk net zo belangrijk is als goede arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Daarom bieden wij:

1. Een uitdagende functie binnen een internationale organisatie.

2. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

3. Hybride werken vanuit huis en/of ons kantoor in Almere.

4. Een auto van de zaak.

5. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

6. Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

7. 25 vakantiedagen.

8. Uitgebreide opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringsmogelijkheden.

9. Een team van collega's dat elkaar ondersteunt en kennis deelt.

10. Ruimte om door te groeien richting consultancy, projectmanagement of specialistische technische rollen.

Bedrijfsbeschrijving

ITS Benelux maakt deel uit van de internationale ITS Group, een organisatie die al meer dan 35 jaar actief is en klanten ondersteunt in Europa, Noord-Amerika en daarbuiten.

Maar wat je vooral merkt als collega, is dat we ondanks onze internationale omvang een nuchtere en persoonlijke organisatie zijn gebleven.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar, vieren successen samen en geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen zich prettig voelen op hun werk.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van het team.

Voel je vrij om its-group.com en printandcopycontrol.com te bezoeken om meer te weten te komen over ons bedrijf en productportfolio.

iTS is gecertificeerd volgens de ISO 9001:2015- en ISO/IEC 27001:2022-normen.

Bedrijfswaarden

Klantgericht: We streven ernaar om te zorgen dat aan de behoeften van onze klanten worden voldaan en overtroffen, en bouwen sterke, langdurige relaties op.

Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.

Om te solliciteren

Denk je dat dit bij je past?

Mooi. Dan hoeven we niet per se een perfect CV te zien.

Ben jij technisch nieuwsgierig, klantgericht en heb je zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen

jobs.title: Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
Are you a creative and proactive marketing student who wants to build a brand and tell the story behind innovative sustainable technology? At Thermeleon, we're looking for a Marketing & Branding Intern to help shape our brand identity, create engaging content, and increase our visibility in the greenhouse horticulture sector.

Our product, the Thermeleon Heat Battery, is an innovative day-night buffer for greenhouses. It improves energy efficiency by strategically reusing surplus heat, reducing natural gas consumption and supporting the transition towards climate-neutral horticulture.

As a Marketing & Branding Intern, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of a wide range of marketing activities, from developing our new brand identity to creating visual content, managing our LinkedIn presence, and communicating our latest developments. You'll work closely with the team to translate complex technology into clear, engaging stories.

Taken

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Branding & Brand Identity: Contribute to the development and implementation of our new branding, ensuring a consistent and recognizable identity across all communication channels.

• Marketing Materials: Design and develop marketing materials, including presentations, brochures, one-pagers, business cards, and other visual assets.

• Content Creation: Create engaging content for LinkedIn, newsletters, our website, and other communication channels to share company updates, projects, and innovations.

• Photography & Videography: Organize and produce visual content, including professional photography, drone footage, team photos, and project shoots at greenhouse locations.

• Social Media Management: Develop and maintain a content calendar, manage our LinkedIn presence, and identify opportunities to increase our reach and engagement.

• Website & Communication: Contribute to improving our website and ensure our messaging is clear, consistent, and aligned with our brand identity.

• Marketing Strategy: Identify creative ways to increase brand awareness, communicate our impact, and position Thermeleon within the sustainable energy and greenhouse horticulture sectors.

Vereisten

- You're currently studying towards a degree in Marketing, Communication, Creative Business, Media, Design, or a related field.
- You have a strong interest in branding, content creation, and digital marketing. You have an eye for design, visual storytelling, and detail.
- You're comfortable creating content for social media, particularly LinkedIn. Experience with design and content creation tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or Figma is a plus.
- You have excellent communication skills in English. Dutch is a plus.
- You're creative, proactive, and enjoy taking ownership of projects from idea to execution.
- You're comfortable working in a dynamic startup environment where priorities can evolve and there's room to experiment.Affinity with sustainability, technology, and innovation is a plus.

Benefits

- The opportunity to shape and develop the brand identity of a growing sustainable technology company.
- Creative freedom and ownership over marketing projects, from the initial concept to the final result.
- Hands-on experience with branding, content creation, social media, and marketing strategy.
- The opportunity to create real-world content, including photography and drone footage at high-tech greenhouse locations.
- A close look into startup life, working directly with the founders and a multidisciplinary team.
- Room to experiment with new ideas, develop your skills, and make a visible impact.
- An internship allowance of €400 per month.

About SOUS

SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.

Our long-term bet is simple. Onze klanten verkopen o.a. stoomreinigers, elektrische scooters, spark machines, pilates-reformers, stoelviltdoppen en autopoetsmiddelen. Wij zorgen dat die producten bij grote retailketens, groothandels en distributeurs terechtkomen, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Niet met alleen een lijst aan leads of een ingeplande afspraak, maar met een getekende deal en een product in het schap.

Onze merken vind je terug bij de Makro, Coolblue, Albert Heijn, Decathlon, Praxis, Karwei, Bouwmaat, Welkoop, Intratuin, MediaMarkt, Intersport, Sport2000, en we zitten aan tafel met grote internationale distribiteurs. Dat zijn dus niet alleen logo's op onze site, dat zijn concrete deals die ons team heeft gerealiseerd. We bestaan sinds 2023, hebben ruim 140 klanttrajecten gedraaid en zijn winstgevend. We zoeken per direct versterking van één a twee business developers voor ons team van zes business developers en twee founders in Utrecht.

Taken

Je bent de business developer van vijf tot zes merken tegelijk. Voor elk merk maak je een projectplan met heldere targets, zoek je de juiste afnemers, vindt je de beslissers, belt, mailt, plant de afspraak, voert het gesprek, maakt het voorstel en onderhandelt tot de handtekening. Daarna blijf jij het aanspreekpunt, want de herhaalorders zijn waar het geld zit, voor de klant en voor jou.

Zo ziet dit er in de praktijk uit. Zelf heb ik voor een van ons klanten een stoomreiniger bij Makro in het assortiment geplaatst, en de tweede,derde en vierde bestelling volgde. Een collega bouwde bij Decathlon een relatie op waar de orders sindsdien blijven doorlopen. In de eerste 30 dagen zorgde dit al voor tienduizenden euro's extra omzet voor onze klant.

Elke week bel je zo'n 80 tot 100 keer, ongeveer twee uur per dag. De rest van je tijd gaat naar het uitdenken van de strategie, klant management, voeren van warme gesprekken, voorstellen uitwerken, op afspraak gaan en het bijhouden van je pijplijn. Elke maandag stuur je de ondernemer achter het merk je weekplan en elke vrijdag je evaluatie. Het repeterende werk, zoals leadlijsten bouwen, research op een keten en de eerste opzet van een pitchdeck, hebben we in Claude Cowork geautomatiseerd met eigen skills. Jij werkt met HubSpot, Aircall, Apollo, Lusha, Notion en Claude, zodat je tijd gaat naar het voeren van gesprekken en closen van deals.

Hoe je start:

In je eerste maand krijg je één of twee eigen klanten. We doen niet aan een meeloopperiode van een kwartaal. Vanaf dag één heb je direct een klant waar jij verantwoordelijk voor bent. Zo leer je accountmanagement, sales en relatiebeheer op de enige manier die werkt, door het te doen. Je doet dat niet alleen. Week 1 zit je in het inwerkprogramma. Hierin neem je onze SOP's door, leer je de systemen kennen en kijk je mee bij een collega op een lopende deal. Daarna heb je een ervaren buddy die je eerste mails valideert en na je eerste gesprekken met je terugkijkt. Wekelijks krijg je salestraining en heb je een 1-op-1 met mij. Dagelijks kun je bij mij en de buddy terecht.

• Je hebt al deals geclosed en kunt dit aantonen. Je hebt ook geleerd waarom een deal niet doorging en wist dit vervolgens snel te implementeren.

• Rijbewijs en een eigen auto zijn een must. Je gaat naar onze klanten en potentiële afnemers toe.

• Vloeiend Nederlands, in spraak en op papier.

• 40 uur per week beschikbaar, in loondienst. 

• Je neemt eigenaarschap over je pijplijn en je resultaten. Je krijgt energie van targets, deals en een product dat door jou uiteindelijk in het schap terug te vinden is.

Benefits

• Basissalaris 3.200 tot 3.700 euro per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.

• De helft van de commissie die wij factureren over deals die jij sluit. Ook over elke herhaalorder, twee tot drie jaar lang. Geen plafond.

• Hybride: drie dagen kantoor in Utrecht, twee dagen thuis.

Herken je jezelf hierin? Stuur je CV en drie regels over een deal waar je het meest trots op bent. Binnen twee werkdagen hoor je van mij. Daarna plannen we een belafspraak in van 20 a 30 minuten, gevolgd door een gesprek op kantoor in Utrecht met mij en een van de business developers. Bij een match vanuit beide kanten ontvang je een concreet aanbod. Van sollicitatie tot handtekening duurt zo'n twee weken en eventueel sneller als het kan.

Luc Broos, mede-oprichter MarketLeap

jobs.title: Marketing and Sales Support Officer
jobs.description:
Avion designs and builds full flight simulators that challenge the status quo in pilot training. As a Dutch OEM in a market dominated by large incumbents, we compete on innovation, agility and close customer relationships. Our simulators support airline training operations worldwide, including our flight training centres in Luton and Mumbai.

We are a compact team where your work is visible, your ideas land directly with decision makers, and no two weeks look the same.

Tasks

The role

As Marketing and Sales Support Officer, you own the full marketing function and support the commercial front line. The balance leans clearly towards marketing, roughly 80% marketing and 20% sales, with the sales side focused on first-line contact and business development rather than closing deals. You are part of the sales team and work closely with our training centres and partners across the industry. The sales side is deliberately a support function — you enable the sales team, you do not carry a quota.

This is a broad, hands-on role. One week you are launching a geo-targeted campaign around a trade show, the next you are hosting press at our Luton training centre or researching a new market segment. You get the freedom to shape how Avion presents itself to the world, and the responsibility that comes with it.

What you will do

Marketing and communications

• Own and maintain the Avion websites, including content, SEO and campaign landing pages.

• Plan and run digital marketing: Google Ads, LinkedIn campaigns and HubSpot, including automated workflows, email sequences and lead nurturing flows.

• Grow and manage Avion's LinkedIn presence with content that resonates in the aviation training community.

• Write and distribute press releases and maintain relationships with trade press worldwide.

• Develop brochures, promo materials and campaign assets for global markets.

• Plan and manage Avion's presence at 3 to 5 international exhibitions per year, including WATS, APATS and EATS, from booth design to post-show follow-up.

Sales support and business development

• Handle first-line sales contact via email, phone and events, and qualify and route leads in HubSpot.

• Support customer fly-outs at our Luton training centre.

• Prepare market research and data analysis to support business development, and flag new segments or initiatives worth exploring. 

• Support the sales team with proposals, tender documentation and market intelligence.

Stakeholder and industry engagement

• Maintain relationships with customers, partners, aviation authorities, trade associations and industry bodies.

• Represent Avion at industry conferences and within professional networks.

Requirements

Who you are

We are not looking for an expert in everything. We are looking for a sharp generalist: someone who understands how the B2B marketing world works, learns new things quickly, and applies common sense to whatever lands on their desk.

You do not need to be able to shoot a commercial video yourself. But you should know what a good one takes, how long it takes, and what it should cost. When a vendor quotes you triple the fair price, you notice. When a new tool like AI can do in an hour what used to take a day, you are already using it. You judge, delegate and decide with confidence across a wide playing field, rather than going deep on one specialism.

• 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, ideally with a commercial or sales support component. Strong candidates with less experience and clear growth potential are also welcome to apply.

• Experienced with HubSpot or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform.

• Comfortable managing websites through a CMS.

• Experienced with Adobe InDesign.

• Fluent in English, written and spoken.

• Willing to travel internationally, sometimes on short notice.

• A self-starter who can plan, prioritise and deliver independently across a broad set of responsibilities.

• Curious about new tools and ways of working, and actively using AI to work smarter.

• Able to brief, assess and manage external specialists such as designers, video makers and agencies, with a good sense of quality, timelines and fair pricing.

Nice to have

• Dutch language skills.

• Experience with Framer.

• Experience with the wider Adobe Creative Cloud suite, such as Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere Pro.

• Affinity with aviation, aerospace or another technical B2B industry.

• Experience with Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

Benefits

What we offer

• A rare breadth of ownership: strategy and execution, marketing and commercial work, in one role.

• Direct access to leadership and short decision lines.

• International exposure: global trade shows, customers on every continent, and training centres in the UK and India.

• Office-first working from Nieuw-Vennep, with room to work from home part of the week.

• A gross monthly salary between EUR 3.243 and EUR 5.405 (excluding 8% holiday allowance), depending on knowledge and experience.

Interested?

Start date: as soon as possible. Send in your CV and a short motivation using our join.com listing. We review applications on a rolling basis.

• Paid Search (SEA) - bezahlte Sichtbarkeit in Google & Co.

Wir suchen eine:n Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (w/m/d) mit starkem Fokus auf Web-Produktentwicklung und AI/LLM-Integration. Du baust unser Team langfristig technisch mit auf und gestaltest unsere GovTech-Plattform für öffentliche Verwaltungen mit.

Standort: Remote-first aus Deutschland oder Österreich (mit gelegentlichen Teamtreffen nach Absprache und der Möglichkeit der Nutzung von Büros in Garching)

Start: Voraussichtlich ab 01.01.2027; den Einstiegstermin vereinbaren wir flexibel mit dir.

Vergütung: Gehalt nach Erfahrung und Expertise; Bonuszahlungen vorgesehen, Mitarbeiterbeteiligungen möglich.

Gesetzlich geforderte Information für Beschäftigung mit Arbeitsort Österreich, absolutes Mindestgehalt: In Österreich beträgt die Mindestvergütung auf Basis des IT-KV 2026 ab 4.061 € brutto monatlich bei 38,5 Wochenstunden, zuzüglich Sonderzahlungen. Das individuell geltende Mindestentgelt ergibt sich aus der Einstufung und den anrechenbaren Vordienstzeiten. Wir sind ausdrücklich bereit, über diesem Mindestentgelt zu bezahlen.

Über uns

Lexaru ist ein junges GovTech-/LegalTech-Startup, das Verwaltungsprozesse mit modernen Anwendungen digitalisiert. Unsere Produkte unterstützen Sachbearbeiter:innen im Verwaltungsalltag und tragen zu effizienter Verwaltung und besseren Services für Bürger:innen bei.

Wir entwickeln Fachanwendungen für Kommunal- und Landesverwaltungen und verbinden moderne Produktentwicklung mit KI-gestützten Funktionen in sicheren und nachvollziehbaren Systemen.

Unterstützt werden wir unter anderem durch das Legal Tech Colab der TU München und die Plattform AI Nation.

Was wir dir bieten

Du arbeitest remote-first mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Austausch mit den Gründern. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und gestaltest gesellschaftlich relevante Produkte für die öffentliche Verwaltung mit.

Wir unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch praktische Erfahrung, regelmäßiges Feedback und eigene Projekte.

Deine Entwicklung gestalten wir gemeinsam mit dir – durch technische Spezialisierung, wachsende Verantwortung oder Führungsaufgaben.

Deine Aufgaben

Produkt & Entwicklung

Du entwickelst Full-Stack Features und vollwertige interne Tools von der Idee über Architektur, Implementierung und Testing bis zum Rollout. Dazu gehören die Gestaltung einfacher UI/UX und das notwendige Backend Engineering. Du baust schnelle MVPs und entwickelst ausgereifte Funktionen für den produktiven Einsatz.

AI / LLM

Du konzipierst und entwickelst LLM-basierte Funktionen und agentische Workflows und integrierst sie in unsere Produkte. Dabei nutzt du Prompt- und Context Engineering, RAG, Tool Calling und strukturierte Modellausgaben. Du triffst Architektur- und Modellentscheidungen, entwickelst geeignete Evaluierungen und stellst durch Guardrails, Logging und Monitoring einen zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher. Qualität, Laufzeit und Kosten verbesserst du anhand messbarer Ergebnisse.

Architektur & Betrieb

Du wirkst an der Architektur unserer Plattform (Services, Datenmodell, Security) mit, verantwortest gemeinsam mit uns Deployment, CI/CD und Monitoring und achtest auf Security, Performance, Kosten und Stabilität im produktiven Betrieb.

Zusammenarbeit & Produktdenken

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und Kunden zusammen, übersetzt Nutzerbedürfnisse in technische Lösungen und klare User Stories und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Du wirkst an der Priorisierung mit und triffst pragmatische technische Entscheidungen.

Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit

• 
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in professioneller Full-Stack Produktentwicklung. Als Richtwert gelten vier oder mehr Jahre. Auch mit weniger Erfahrung freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du uns von deiner Expertise überzeugst.

• 
Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript und modernen Frontend-Frameworks, idealerweise Svelte oder Vue.

• 
Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in modernen Backend-Technologien wie Node.js oder Django.

• 
Du hast Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken, idealerweise PostgreSQL, einschließlich Schema-Design und Grundlagen der Performanceoptimierung.

• 
Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb LLM-basierter Anwendungen, einschließlich RAG, Tool Calling und strukturierter Modellausgaben. Du kannst KI-Workflows eigenständig entwerfen, integrieren und ihre Qualität durch systematische Evaluation und Fehleranalyse weiterentwickeln.

• 
Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, kommunizierst klar und bringst Aufgaben zu Ende. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen.

• 
Du möchtest verstehen, wie Fachverfahren in Verwaltungen funktionieren, um sinnvolle UIs und Nutzerflüsse zu bauen.

• 
Du kannst in einer frühen Phase mit wenigen Prozessstrukturen selbst priorisieren und Entscheidungen treffen.

• 
Du führst saubere Dokumentation, zum Beispiel Architektur-Notizen, ADRs und Onboarding-Docs.

• 
Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wir gehen den Bewerbungsprozess Schritt für Schritt mit dir durch. Du weißt dabei immer, wo du gerade stehst und was als Nächstes folgt.

•

Nach erfolgreicher Bewertung deiner Bewerbung laden wir dich ein, einen vertraulichen Take-Home Case zu bearbeiten.

•

In einem zweiteiligen Gespräch besprechen wir deinen Case und deine Bewerbung einschließlich konkreter Vergütungsmodelle.

Wir sprechen über unsere Zusammenarbeit, Arbeitsweise und gegenseitigen Erwartungen. Deine Reisekosten übernehmen wir.

•

Gleichbehandlung

jobs.title: (Senior) Operations Manager // AI Music Video Platform
jobs.description:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work.

We've got here with a small team and very little overhead. Now we're growing quickly, and the operational side of the company - finance, people admin, tooling, office, contracts - run through the founder and Founders Associate. We're looking for the person who takes that over and makes it quietly reliable.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be the one the tax firm calls, the one who makes sure a new hire is on payroll and has a laptop and every tool on day one, the one who knows when every contract and insurance renews, and the one who fixes reconciliation mess instead of filing a ticket about it. You'll work directly with the founder, alongside our Founder's Associate and with our external accountants and virtual assistant.

Tasks

• 
Own finance operations: be the point of contact for our tax firm and payroll provider, run the monthly close inputs, keep Stripe invoicing, refunds and credit notes clean and reconciled, and resolve open questions before they reach the founder

• 
Assemble a monthly numbers pack - revenue, cash, margin, cloud costs, payroll, headcount - from Stripe, the accountants and our internal data

• 
Own people administration: contracts, probation periods, holidays, absence and time tracking, documents and compliance. Be the person the team asks about payslips, holiday balances and contract

• 
Manage our virtual assistant and the work we outsource

• 
Own tool access, equipment and IT: accounts, licences, laptops, security basics, and the day-one setup for every new hire from the onboarding checklist

• 
Own the office: lease, supplies, equipment, access, the practical things that make the place work

• 
Track every recurring vendor, contract, insurance and compliance obligation in one place so nothing depends on somebody remembering it

• 
Handle the booking, budget and logistics behind team events and the annual offsite

Requirements

• 
You have 3–6 years of experience in operations, finance operations or people operations at a small, fast-growing company, and have been the person who kept it running

• 
You have personally owned the relationship with an external tax firm and payroll provider, including monthly close and the questions that come with it

• 
You are hands-on with Stripe or a comparable payment system and understand invoices, refunds, credit notes and reconciliation; DATEV experience is a strong plus

• 
You are familiar with Personio or a similar HRIS and know German employment administration

• 
You make things tidy without being asked, close loops reliably, and are slightly allergic to loose ends

• 
You are comfortable making small decisions on your own and bringing the founder only the ones that need him

• 
You communicate clearly in German and English

• 
You are based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

• 
Experience in consumer subscription or SaaS, especially with Stripe at volume and international VAT

• 
Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, and Linear administration

• 
You have worked in both a structured company and a scrappy startup and know what is worth copying from each

How we measure success

Within your first month, you’ve audited all recurring finance, admin, and tooling tasks currently handled by the founder, agreed on clear ownership of what you’ll take over, established yourself as the main point of contact for our tax firm, and mapped every vendor, contract, and compliance deadline.

Within 90 days, finance operations, people admin, tool access, and office management run smoothly without input from the founder or Founder's Associate. The founder has received the monthly financial numbers pack twice without having to put it together himself. Our Founder's Associate can hand you a new hire, and you'll have them on payroll, fully equipped, and ready to go within a day.

Within a year, a new hire can be contracted, paid, equipped, and fully onboarded into our systems without any involvement from the founder. No contract renewal or compliance deadline has been missed, and the company has scaled significantly without operational processes becoming a bottleneck.

Benefits

VSOPs and profit sharing, bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning and development support, productivity tools, a headphone allowance, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus.

Neural Frames is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and are committed to building an inclusive and supportive workplace.

jobs.title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
jobs.description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni)

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We’re looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You’ll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You’ll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do

  • Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.
  • Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.
  • Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.
  • Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You’ll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Core qualifications

  • Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master’s degree program.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.
  • Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.
  • An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.
  • Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.

Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive.

What we offer

Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You’ll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.
