jobs.title: (Senior) Principal Mendix Developer
jobs.description:
Excited to lead teams and architect Mendix solutions that are scalable, future-ready and make a real difference?

At Valcon, we help organisations across Europe become fit for the future – combining consulting, data and technology to realise real transformation. We work end-to-end: from boardroom strategy to concrete implementation on the work floor. Our approach is pragmatic, fast and collaborative. No buzzwords, just results.

Our culture is defined by ownership, entrepreneurship and continuous learning. We believe in growing together – through mentorship, trust and the freedom to shape your own path. We offer flexibility, challenge, and the opportunity to work on projects that matter.

You’ll join our fast-growing Low-Code capability, with over 100 Mendix professionals across Europe – including 26 experts and 3 MVPs in the Netherlands alone. Our team works on high-impact projects for clients like IND/COA, Prorail, Defensie, BAM, Heineken with a strong focus on collaboration, quality and long-term solutions. Many of our projects are international – such as our recent engagement in Denmark, where our hybrid team (NL, DK, KR) delivers scalable solutions from design to delivery. Whether you want to specialise, coach others or lead engagements: you’ll find the space and support to grow.

Tasks

What will you do?

As a (Senior) Principal Mendix Consultant, you bring together strategic thinking, platform expertise and strong leadership. You’ll lead multidisciplinary project or DevOps teams with full end-to-end ownership – from uncovering client needs to delivering scalable, future-ready applications.

You take the lead in workshops, architecture and design decisions, translating complex business challenges into impactful IT-solutions – ranging from mobile and workflow apps to data-driven and integrated platforms. Increasingly, you’ll work on solutions that leverage AI, smart automation and advanced integrations to unlock new business value.

Beyond delivery, you’ll play a key role in shaping our Low-Code capability. You help scale teams, raise engineering standards, and contribute to strategy, talent development and internal best practices. As a technical lead, you’re also actively involved in pre-sales, shaping proposals and leading proof-of-concepts for new clients.

Depending on your interests, you can further grow towards strategic client ownership, technical depth or mentoring responsibilities – always with the freedom to shape your own path. 

Among your responsibilities will be the following:

• Designing, developing and testing innovative Mendix solutions in an agile way.

• Leading multidisciplinary teams and acting as technical lead in delivery projects: guiding architecture, workshops, design decisions, and quality

• Leading and coaching multiple Mendix teams, sometimes across different clients and domains.

• Tackling complex technical challenges and shaping long-term platform strategies.

• Coaching developers and consultants to grow their skills and confidence with the Mendix platform.

• Supporting pre-sales activities and helping shape client proposals and proof-of-concepts.

• Strengthening our Low-Code capability through improved standards, best practices and strategic team development.

Requirements

Experience:

• A completed Bachelor’s, Master’s or technical HBO degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Econometrics, Mathematics or a related field.

• At least 4 years of working experience as Mendix specialist/application developer and Mendix Advanced Developer certification.

• Nice to have: Mendix Expert Developer Certification and/or a specialisation in a domain like UI/UX, Architecture or custom (react/java) development.

• Fluent in Dutch and English

• Located in The Netherlands

Benefits

What do we offer you?

• Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.

• An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.

• Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself.

• Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer:

• Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.

• A company car or mobility budget.

• A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).

• An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.

• The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.

• A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

Ready to apply?

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values – Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity – resonate with you?

Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

jobs.title: Senior Java/Kotlin Engineer
jobs.description:
Bij Creetion bouw je mee aan een sterke Java/Kotlin-community. Een plek waar vakmanschap de norm is, kennisdeling vanzelfsprekend, en jij de ruimte krijgt om te excelleren met collega’s die je inhoudelijk beter maken. Geen hype, geen snelle groei. Wel een cultuur waarin je serieus genomen wordt en impact maakt op projecten die ertoe doen. 

Sluit jij je aan bij een engineering cultuur die je uitdaagt en beter maakt?

Taken

Je werkt aan complexe, cloud‑native oplossingen voor toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland. In omgevingen waar schaalbaarheid, security en performance core business zijn. Je hebt invloed op architectuurkeuzes en werkt in teams waar kwaliteit boven buzzwords gaat.

Zo maak jij impact

• Ontwerp en bouw high-performance, cloud-native services met Spring Boot in Java 21+ en/of Kotlin.

• Werk met event-driven architecturen waarin dagelijks (honderden) miljoenen events worden verwerkt.

• Richt CI/CD‑pipelines in en deploy via GitOps met Kubernetes en ArgoCD op Azure, AWS of GCP.

• Neem eigenaarschap over architectuur, performance en reliability (SLO’s/SLA’s, resilience-patterns, idempotency, backpressure).

• Observeer en optimaliseer met metrics/logging/tracing (Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry) en security‑by‑design (OAuth2/OIDC, secrets, policies).

• Versnel met agentic AI zoals Claude, Cursor en Junie.

• Deel kennis actief binnen onze community en bij klanten.

Vereisten

Wat breng je mee?

• Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als software engineer (hbo/wo of aantoonbaar gelijkwaardig niveau).

• Sterke kennis van Java (21+) en/of Kotlin.

• Ervaring met Spring Boot, cloud-native development en event-driven architectuur.

• Bekend met Kubernetes en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines d.m.v. GitOps.

• Ervaring met Kafka of vergelijkbare messaging-technologieën.

• Ervaring met AWS, Azure, of GCP.

• Pluspunt: kennis van frontend frameworks zoals Angular of React voor full-stack eigenaarschap.

• Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en bent communicatief sterk. 

• Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen en kunt technische keuzes, op verschillende niveaus, helder uitleggen.

Benefits

• Keuzevrijheid in beloning:

• Vast salaris: €5.000 – €8.000 + bonus

• Of een aantrekkelijke 70/30-regeling

• Jij kiest hoe je reist: Goede leaseregeling of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

• Hybride werken.

• Investering in jouw groei: Ruim opleidingsbudget en toegang tot conferenties.

• Een echte engineering community: Collega’s die precies weten wat er speelt in de markt.

• Goede basis: Pensioen en collectieve verzekeringen.

• Projecten die ertoe doen: Kritische systemen in fintech, energie, infrastructuur en overheid.

Wat maakt ons anders?

• Engineering‑led leadership: Onze richting wordt bepaald door ervaren engineers die zelf nog dagelijks coderen en spreken op internationale conferenties. Keuzes zijn inhoudelijk, niet politiek.

• Samen naar conferenties: We gaan samen naar conferenties en meetups. Heb je de ambitie om te spreken? We helpen je d.m.v. coaching, dry‑runs en reviews.

Zelf weer controle krijgen over je eigen data. Dat is de missie van stichting Nederlandse Datakluis. Wij ontwikkelen software waarmee mensen zelf bepalen welke data ze opslaan in hun persoonlijke datakluis, wat ze delen, met wie en waarom. Geen tracking, geen dataslurpers, geen ondoorzichtige voorwaarden. Gewoon: autonomie over je eigen digitale leven. We gebruiken de open standaard Solid, bedacht door sir Tim Berners-Lee himself. We zijn een groeiend team van idealisten, denkers en doeners met een sterke missie. We zijn in korte tijd koploper geworden in deze revolutionaire technologie die de basis gaat leggen voor persoonlijke AI-assistenten. Onze aanpak? Gestart vanuit een samenwerking met de grootste Nederlandse mediabedrijven rollen we eind van het jaar onze software uit op de grootste websites van Nederland en bouwen vanuit daar verder naar andere sectoren en andere toepassingen. Ons doel? Digitale autonomie voor miljoenen mensen met een eerlijker internet als resultaat. 

Missie

Wij vinden dat het internet kapot is: en dat het anders kan. Wij geven mensen controle over hun persoonlijke data, zodat die data niet langer enkel waarde oplevert voor grote platformen en advertentienetwerken, maar vooral mensen zelf. Onze missie is om een infrastructuur te bouwen waarin vertrouwen, transparantie en menselijke regie centraal staan. Daarmee creëren we ruimte voor eerlijke markten, inclusieve digitale diensten en persoonlijke AI-oplossingen die werken vóór mensen, niet over hen heen. We willen zoveel mogelijk Nederlanders een persoonlijke datakluis geven en deze laten benutten voor zoveel mogelijk toepassingen. Dit is meer dan een product. Dit is de start van een beweging.

• Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar (voor medior) of 5+ jaar (voor senior).

jobs.title: Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

About The Exploration Company

At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuelled in orbit, carrying cargo and potentially humans in the long run. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, which is why we develop our own propulsion systems, aiming for the highest level of efficiency and reliability.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer to join the engine control and monitoring team of Storm, our high-thrust LOX/LCH4 cryogenic rocket engine. Working alongside senior control engineers, you will develop and test control and monitoring algorithms, work with the engine functional models provided by the functional team, contribute to setting up the controller development environment, and help verify the controller through Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop testing and during engine test campaigns. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for a recent graduate with strong control fundamentals who wants to learn on real hardware and progressively grow into full ownership of safety-critical engine control functions.

Key responsibilities:

1. Control & Monitoring Algorithm Development

• Design and implement engine control and monitoring algorithms, following the software team's rules, guidelines and auto-coding practices.

• Contribute to the definition of the engine regulation strategy (thrust and mixture ratio control, chill-down, start-up and shutdown transients) together with functional and system engineers.

• Support the definition of control and monitoring requirements for engine subsystems (valves, pumps, sensors, controller, software).

2. Simulation & Controller Development Environment

• Contribute to setting up the controller development environment: toolchain, model and code configuration management, auto-coding chain, and the MiL/SiL/HiL simulation and test infrastructure.

• Integrate the engine functional models delivered by the functional team (turbopumps, valves, combustion devices, cryogenic feed lines; steady-state, transient and chill-down) into the control design and simulation environment, deriving simplified or linearised models for controller synthesis where needed.

• Run closed-loop simulations to assess controller performance, stability margins and robustness to model uncertainties.

• Feed test results back to the functional team to support model correlation, and flag model limitations that matter for control.

3. Health Monitoring & Fault Management

• Contribute to the engine monitoring strategy that assesses the health status of the engine and its subsystems (combustion chamber, turbopumps, valves…).

• Implement fault detection and sensor validation logic for both real-time protection and post-test analysis.

• Support failure mode analyses (FMEA) and the management of failure modes, paving the way for engine reusability.

4. Validation, Testing & Documentation

• Prepare and run Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop (MiL, SiL, HiL) test campaigns to verify the control and monitoring functions at each step, from Simulink model to embedded code on target hardware.

• Support Storm engine and component cryogenic (LOX/LCH4) test campaigns: test preparation, on-site support, data processing and post-test analysis.

• Produce clear development documentation: specifications, test procedures, test reports and justification files.

What we would love to see from you:

• Master's degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace, Electrical, Control or Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Recent graduate (or graduating within the next months); no professional experience required. A master's thesis, internship or academic project in control, propulsion or embedded systems is a strong plus.

• Solid fundamentals in control theory, both classical and modern (state-space, robustness, digital control).

• Practical use of MATLAB/Simulink and Python through coursework or projects; basic knowledge of C/C++.

• Basic understanding of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics, and a strong interest in cryogenic propulsion and turbomachinery.

• Fluent in English.

Nice to Have: 

• Exposure to MiL/SiL/HiL testing or real-time embedded systems.

• Experience with auto-coding from Simulink models.

• Familiarity with safety-critical design practices, reliability engineering or failure mode analysis.

• Interest or experience in data science applied to health monitoring and anomaly detection.

• Knowledge of space standards (ECSS, MIL-STD, NASA-HBK…).

• German and/or French.

Skills & Behaviours:

• Eagerness to learn and to take on increasing ownership under the guidance of senior engineers.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to draw useful conclusions from partial or contradictory data.

• Clear oral and written communication; comfortable working closely with engine, avionics, software and test teams.

• Organised, able to prioritise tasks and deliver within time constraints.

• Positive, flexible attitude and enthusiasm for space exploration.

• Behaviour consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: 

• 
We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

• 
We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them 

• 
We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do

• Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.

• Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.

• Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.

• Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Core qualifications

• Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program.

• Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.

• Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.

• An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.

• Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.

Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive.

What we offer

Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You'll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods.

Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Overview of the Role:

InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing high-value opportunities with some of the largest brands across non-gaming verticals. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising.

You'll join a high-performing team spanning EMEA Sales, Client Growth, and Media Buying under App Performance Solutions — a team that will actively support your growth and success within the InMobi programmatic sales ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV.

This is a role for true hunters — those who thrive on building pipelines from scratch, opening doors others can't, and turning cold conversations into long-term revenue partnerships.

This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed.

The Impact You'll Make: 

As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sales from a portfolio of Direct Brands and Performance Agencies across the DACH region by creating and selling effective App Performance Solutions. You will also actively participate in shaping InMobi's App Performance sales strategy, go-to-market approach, and execution plan across your key region within EMEA.

• Identify, acquire, advise, and develop new relationships with targeted, strategic brands, agencies, and partners that ensure the growth and long-term success of InMobi's suite of App Performance Solutions

• Leverage your knowledge of the market landscape and InMobi's unique selling propositions and differentiators to develop new and enduring business with advertisers — including navigating the Programmatic and walled garden ecosystems to position InMobi App Performance Solutions as a must-have for brands' app growth and retention strategies

• Maintain strong relationships with ecosystem influencers, MMPs, agencies, and partners to keep InMobi top of mind for their clients

• Own the entire sales lifecycle — from outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification to proposal building, nurturing, activation, and strategic growth consulting

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, execution, and account handover to the Growth team

• Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth

• Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, leveraging CRM tools for accurate forecasting and performance tracking

• Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management

The Experience We Need: 

• Industry experience. You bring 5+ years of hunting and selling experience to App businesses and Performance Agencies. You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them.

• An advertising technology expert. You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. Experience at a leading Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP, or other online advertising company is required. You think deeply about clients' growth and retention challenges and know how to recommend the right solutions.

In a marketplace flooded with vendors, your clients think of you first — not because you sold them, but because you solved for them.

• Believe in lifelong learning — we welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product (m/f/d) | Berlin | Full-Time

Location: Berlin, Germany (office first)
Start date: As soon as possible
Company: Venture-backed AI startup, early stage

About the Company

We’re a fast-growing AI company building agents for complex, high-stakes enterprise workflows in public procurement, one of Europe’s largest and least digitised markets. Our product takes on the slow, manual, document-heavy work behind public tenders. That saves businesses and the public sector a great deal of wasted time and money.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product to own and scale our product function. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll be the most senior product person in the company and work directly with the founders and engineering team. You’ll personally drive discovery, prioritisation and delivery. As we grow, you’ll set up how the product function works: its processes, rituals and culture. When the time is right, you’ll hire the team around you.

What You’ll Do

• Own the product strategy and roadmap, setting direction alongside the founders, engineering and customers.

• Lead core product initiatives end to end, from discovery and scoping through launch and iteration. You’ll ship AI products that enterprise customers rely on.

• Stay close to the product: test, refine and pressure-test our agents, and understand how prompts, context and evaluations shape quality.

• Spend real time with customers. Uncover requirements, turn noisy feedback into clear priorities and become a trusted partner to their business.

• Build the product function. Define how we discover, prioritise, ship and measure, and lay the foundations for a future product team.

• Work with GTM on positioning and join sales conversations where product insight wins deals.

Who You Are

• 5+ years in product management or a closely related role (founder, early operator, consulting into product), with a strong record of shipping.

• A startup operator at heart. You’ve done your best work at early-stage companies, ideally as one of the first product hires or as a founder. Experience only at large corporates won’t be the right fit for this role.

• A strong all-rounder, as comfortable setting strategy as writing a detailed spec, debugging an edge case or jumping on a sales call.

• Exceptional product sense and user empathy. You look past the surface of a feature request to find the root problem.

• Technically curious. You don’t need a CS degree or coding skills, but you’re confident working with engineers and exploring what AI can and can’t do.

• A clear communicator who uses both qualitative and quantitative reasoning to make and explain decisions.

• Based in Berlin or ready to relocate.

• Fluent in English and German (required for our customer base).

• Nice to have: B2B or enterprise software experience (strongly preferred), hands-on work with AI/LLM products, or exposure to public sector or regulated markets.

You’ll Thrive If

• You love building from 0 to 1. You don’t need a roadmap handed to you, and you enjoy creating structure where there is none.

• You move fast and are energised by an intense, ambitious environment.

• You have a “no task is too small” mindset and lead by doing.

• You love being in the office and believe in-person collaboration drives speed.

What’s In It For You

• Ownership from day one. You’ll define the product, with direct access to the founders and zero red tape.

• A role that grows with you. As the company scales, so do your scope and your team.

• Shared upside: top-of-market compensation and generous equity.

• A mission that matters. You won’t be optimising ad clicks. You’ll be helping businesses and the public sector cut waste on a huge scale.

Our Process

• Review: All applications reviewed within 5 days.

• Intro call: 30 minutes on your background and motivations.

• Product deep dive (remote): 1 hour on your product thinking and problem-solving.

• On-site (half day): Work through a real product use case with the team, followed by 1:1s with Engineering and GTM.

• Offer: A quick final decision and transparent feedback straight after the on-site.

How to Apply

Apply through this posting with:

• Your CV

• A few lines on what excites you about this role

• Optional: links to products you’ve shipped

jobs.title: Mandatory Internship – Product Development Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About ecopals

ecopals is building the leading performance additive platform for asphalt and bitumen modification, engineered for regional, sovereign supply chains and backed by strong unit economics. Our current product line is built on high-performance polymers, with further additive categories in active development. In the last two years, we have scaled to active operations in more than 10 EU countries, while continuously expanding our product and technology platform.

As we enter our next growth phase, we are opening a mandatory internship position for Product Development Engineer (m/f/d). The role works closely with our R&D team on the identification, assessment and development of new products, formulations and production routes.

The role combines materials science and engineering with data analysis and modern AI-assisted technical workflows, with a strong emphasis on using these tools to accelerate development without compromising scientific rigor.

Tasks

In this internship, you will help turn early technical ideas into structured development programmes and support the evaluation of which product and process routes are worth pursuing.

Areas of responsibility

• 
Product development research. Researching potential development routes for new products, formulations and processes based on scientific literature, technical documentation, experimental results and first-principles understanding.

• 
Development-route assessment. Comparing materials, technologies, mechanisms and production concepts and identifying promising routes for further development.

• 
Technical and economic feasibility. Preparing structured assessments and reports on technical feasibility, process requirements, raw materials, costs and potential economic viability.

• 
Test programme development. Supporting the design of experimental programmes, including formulation matrices, variables, testing methods and evaluation criteria.

• 
Experimental and laboratory support. Preparing material samples for internal testing, external laboratories and customers; assisting with the preparation and execution of in-house experimental setups; and supporting the documentation and evaluation of experimental results.

• 
Laboratory coordination. Supporting the planning and coordination of testing activities with internal and external laboratories, suppliers and technical partners.

• 
Data analysis. Processing and evaluating experimental data to identify trends, correlations, performance drivers and development priorities.

• 
Technical data management. Building and maintaining structured databases for formulations, raw materials, test results, literature and development projects.

• 
Programming, data analysis and AI-assisted workflows. Using Python and modern AI-assisted development tools, including AI agents, to clean, structure, analyse and visualize technical data; automate repetitive R&D tasks; support technical research; and build internal analytical workflows. A key part of the role is learning to use these tools effectively and responsibly, with proper validation, documentation and control of the resulting work.

• 
Technical standards and regulations. Researching and analysing standards, specifications and regulatory requirements relevant to products under development and their potential applications.

• 
Technical reporting. Preparing clear technical reports and decision documents that translate scientific, experimental and economic information into actionable development recommendations.

• 
Independent development work. Taking ownership of defined development questions and following them from initial research through analysis and experimental validation.

Requirements

• 
Currently completing a Master’s degree or comparable advanced university programme in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Process Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering or a related field.

• 
Good foundations in chemistry, materials science, construction materials and/or industrial processes.

• 
At least two years of relevant experience in one or more of the activities described above, gained through internships, research projects, student assistant positions, laboratory work, industrial projects or professional experience.

• 
Strong analytical skills and confidence working with quantitative technical and experimental data.

• 
Programming and data-analysis skills, preferably with Python or comparable tools. Previous experience with AI-assisted coding or AI agents is valuable but not required. More important is the ability and willingness to rapidly adopt these workflows and use them rigorously — understanding what the tools are doing, checking their outputs, identifying errors and ensuring that analyses remain technically sound and reproducible.

• 
Ability to work systematically with scientific literature, experimental results and complex technical information.

• 
Ability to move between fundamental scientific questions and practical engineering and production constraints.

• 
A structured and independent way of working, with a strong sense of ownership.

• 
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; German is a plus.

• 
An entrepreneurial and pragmatic mindset, with genuine interest in developing technologies that can move from research into industrial application.

Your Benefits

• 
Direct involvement in product development, contributing to technologies that may become future ecopals products.

• 
Exposure to the full development process, from scientific principles and formulation concepts to processes, testing and economic assessment.

• 
Practical experimental experience, supporting material preparation, in-house experiments and laboratory validation activities.

• 
Hands-on experience with technical data and analytical tools, including opportunities to improve how R&D data is structured, analysed and used for decision making.

• 
Practical experience with AI-assisted R&D workflows, including programming, automation and diligent use of AI agents as technical working tools.

• 
Proximity to decision making, working closely with R&D and company leadership on which development routes to pursue.

• 
Responsibility from an early stage, with ownership of defined technical work packages and development questions.

• 
A steep learning curve across materials science, chemistry, industrial processes, data analysis and applied R&D.

• 
Practical exposure to industrial R&D, including collaboration with laboratories, suppliers and technical partners.

• 
Meaningful impact, contributing to technologies designed to reduce emissions, improve circularity and increase the performance of critical infrastructure.

This position is a mandatory internship. A corresponding confirmation from your academic institution, stating the requirement to complete an internship, must be provided prior to the start of the internship.

Sounds like you? We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and cover letter.

Aufbauen, Betreiben und Weiterentwickeln unserer Hosting- und Deployment-Infrastruktur für KI-Anwendungen, Schnittstellen und Automatisierungen

Automatisieren von Builds, Tests und Deployments über CI/CD-Pipelines

Überwachen von Ressourcenverbrauch und Infrastrukturkosten und Verbessern von Leistung und Wirtschaftlichkeit

Benefits

Verantwortung für die Infrastruktur hinter echten KI-Lösungen im Mittelstand

Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau einheitlicher Betriebs- und Sicherheitsstandards

Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Entwicklerteam und kurze Entscheidungswege

Raum für Automatisierung und technische Verbesserungen, die den Arbeitsalltag des gesamten Teams erleichtern

Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Dingolfing (84130)

Unsere Haltung

Verstehen

Bevor wir etwas bauen, wollen wir das Unternehmen, die Menschen und die täglichen Abläufe wirklich verstehen. Wir versetzen uns in die Rolle unserer Kunden und fragen nicht zuerst, was technisch möglich ist, sondern was im Alltag wirklich hilft.

Nur dann entstehen Lösungen, die nicht am Bedarf vorbeigehen, sondern genutzt werden, Aufwand reduzieren und Probleme tatsächlich lösen.

Anpacken

Wir übernehmen Verantwortung und bleiben dran, bis der Job erledigt ist. Wir sprechen Probleme offen an, schaffen Klarheit und lösen sie, statt sie weiterzureichen.

Nicht alles läuft sofort glatt. Entscheidend ist, dass wir handeln, uns Hilfe holen, wenn sie nötig ist, und den Extra-Meter gehen, wenn es für den Erfolg unserer Kunden notwendig ist.

Liefern

KI ist für uns kein Selbstzweck. Gute Ideen, Konzepte oder Präsentationen reichen nicht.

Entscheidend ist, dass eine Lösung im Alltag funktioniert, verlässlich eingesetzt werden kann und für unsere Kunden einen echten Unterschied macht. Wir werden nicht dafür bezahlt, über Möglichkeiten zu sprechen. Wir werden dafür bezahlt, Ergebnisse zu liefern.

Besser werden

Wir haben einen hohen Anspruch an unsere Arbeit und wissen gleichzeitig, dass man nie auslernt. Wir testen, lernen, holen Feedback ein und denken über den ersten Lösungsansatz hinaus.

Fehler passieren. Entscheidend ist, dass wir sie offen ansprechen, daraus lernen und sie nicht zweimal machen. So werden unsere Lösungen, unsere Zusammenarbeit und unser Anspruch jeden Tag besser.

Kurzbewerbung mit Lebenslauf und kurzer Beschreibung deiner bisherigen Infrastruktur- und Betriebsverantwortung

• 
Erstgespräch zum gegenseitigen Kennenlernen

• 
Praxisnahes Gespräch mit Geschäftsführung und Entwicklerteam

• 
Angebot

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich jetzt.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Du verantwortest das Controlling und die Finanzsteuerung und berichtest an das Management Board.

In diesem Rahmen bist du die Person, die weiß, wo die Zahlen stehen, warum sie dort stehen und wie sich Ergebnis, Kosten, Liquidität und Eigenmittel entwickeln werden.

Der Kern der Rolle hat zwei Seiten: die regulatorische Pflicht und eine Steuerung, mit der wir jede Finanzfrage jederzeit in wenigen Minuten beantworten können. Business Cases und Investor Reporting kommen dazu und wachsen mit dir.

Aufgaben

• 
Den Jahresabschluss nach HGB und RechKredV erstellen, ergänzt um die RechZahlV-Posten für unser Zahlungsgeschäft, und die Prüfung gemeinsam mit unserer Steuerkanzlei und Abschlussprüfer durchführen.

Regulatorische Planzahlen, etwa die Eigenmittelanforderung, aus der Bilanzplanung ableiten und in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsleitung laufend überwachen.

Cashflow- und Runway-Planung führen und Finanzierungsbedarf früh sichtbar machen.

•

Aus der Praxiserfahrung heraus Input liefern, um Finanzprozesse, Tools und das interne Kontrollsystem gemeinsam mit unserem AI-Dev-Team auszubauen.

Wen wir suchen

• 
Du bist Controller:in (idealerweise aus einem regulierten Institut) und hast Jahresabschluss und Meldewesen selbst verantwortet.

• 
Abweichungen erkennst du früh: Wenn sich Eigenmittel, Liquidität oder Kosten in die falsche Richtung bewegen, liegt deine Analyse mit Optionen auf dem Tisch, solange noch Zeit zum Handeln ist.

Deine Forecasts halten auch Monate später, und wo sie abweichen, kannst du erklären, warum.

Meldefristen und Prüfungsanforderungen baust du so in die Abläufe ein, dass vor dem Stichtag keine Ad-hoc Aktion nötig ist.

Du entscheidest auch mit unvollständigen Informationen, sagst klar, wenn etwas nicht geht, und stellst einen Prozess um, sobald er nicht mehr passt.

Qualifikation

Must-Haves

Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Finanzen, Controlling oder einem verwandten Feld.

Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling oder Rechnungswesen, idealerweise in einem regulierten Institut (nach KWG, ZAG oder MiCAR) oder in der Prüfung entsprechender Institute.

Eigenständig erstellte Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB, sowie Erfahrung mit Liquiditäts- und Kontrahentenrisiken sowie Risikotragfähigkeit.

Offenheit: Reporting mit AI-Werkzeugen neu aufsetzen.

Fließend Deutsch und Englisch (C1 oder höher).

Nice-to-Haves

Benefits

30 Tage Urlaub, dazu jeweils ein halber Tag frei an Heiligabend und Silvester, und bei Bedarf zusätzlicher unbezahlter Urlaub, um die Akkus wieder aufzuladen.

jobs.title: Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
Help shape the future of robotics in construction.

ABOUT XYZ REALITY

XYZ Reality created the world’s first and only engineering-grade augmented reality solution, purpose-built for the construction industry. Our holographic technology sits within The Atom, a smart, site-safe headset and hardhat, and is used on live projects to ensure schemes are delivered on time and on budget.

XYZ has grown to over 150 staff across the UK, US and Europe, and works with mission-critical organisations and construction companies to deliver major projects.

THE ROLE

Construction sites are some of the hardest environments for robot autonomy: they change every day and are full of clutter, obstacles and people. XYZ Reality’s robotics programme is extending our technology toward robots that can operate reliably in them, from autonomous data collection and construction progress capture through to executing construction tasks.

We’re looking for a Robotics Engineer to make that real. You’ll work hands-on with robot hardware in our London office, using a modern stack (ROS 2, NVIDIA Isaac Lab, learning-based control), and see your work tested in real construction environments, not just in simulation.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on robot software and algorithmic control, backed by a good working knowledge of robot hardware. If you have strong robotics fundamentals from an MSc, PhD or applied research group, love making systems work on real robots, and want your ideas to shape the direction of a programme, we want to hear from you.

This is an office-based role at our London site in Angel, Islington.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• 
Integrate robots with XYZ’s software, bringing up ROS / ROS 2 interfaces, robot control, sensors, compute and data flows, and building repeatable tools for bring-up, configuration, logging and monitoring.

• 
Establish reliable baseline control and develop task-specific behaviours for navigation, positioning and capture, training and tuning control policies in simulation and validating them on hardware.

• 
Develop localisation-aware path planning, waypoint execution and obstacle handling, working with project and site teams to turn work plans and BIM-derived locations into robot missions.

• 
Integrate capture payloads so images, pose, timing and mission status flow reliably into XYZ’s construction progress workflows, working with navigation, SLAM and perception colleagues.

• 
Design test scenarios and measure mission completion, coverage, localisation quality, intervention, recovery and repeatability, improving the system through measured iterations.

• 
Bring technical expertise and new ideas to the programme, comparing scripted, motion-planning and learning-based approaches and helping shape what comes next.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 
MSc or PhD in Robotics, Controls, Computer Science, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent applied robotics experience. Industry experience is not required.

• 
Hands-on experience building, programming or directly controlling a physical robot, from an academic project, research lab or industry.

• 
Strong Python and C++, practical ROS experience (ideally ROS 2) and working knowledge of kinematics, coordinate frames, feedback control, state estimation, path planning and robot hardware.

• 
Experience training or tuning robot control policies (e.g. reinforcement or imitation learning) using NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim or similar tools, with a rigorous experimental approach.

• 
The right to work in the UK. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

• 
ROS / ROS 2, Python & C++

• 
Robot control, kinematics, state estimation & path planning

• 
NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim, reinforcement or imitation learning

• 
Sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware (desirable)

• 
Navigation, SLAM, perception & sensor fusion (desirable)

• 
Mobile or field robotics, BIM/CAD or construction technology (desirable)

BENEFITS

🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

🎄 Christmas shutdown days on top of leave allowance (2–4 per year usually)

🚇 Office located within a 5-minute walk from Angel station

🪙 Annual salary reviews

🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties

🍣 Free lunch on Thursdays, followed by after-work drinks

💰 Employee referral scheme

🚀 Make a real-world impact by helping transform the construction industry

jobs.description:
💰 £40,000–£45,000

📍 Salary based on London. Other locations may vary.

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Behind the product is a finance function that needs to be as fast and reliable as the platform itself.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring an Assistant Accountant to own the accounting engine of the finance team: the ledger, the month-end close, and the admin that keeps both clean. Our day-to-day transaction processing is supported by an outsourced bookkeeping partner. You'll own the quality of that work, the reconciliations behind it, and everything between a receipt landing and a number reaching the board pack.

Everything else in finance, reporting, forecasting and investor diligence depends on the ledger being right. You'll make sure it is: reviewing what goes in, reconciling what comes out, and closing the month on time. About a quarter of the role is finance admin. It means running the invoice inbox, chasing receipts and keeping supplier records clean, and it's what keeps the numbers right.

🚀 What You'll Do

Ledger and close

• 
Review and own the ledger in Xero, including our outsourced bookkeepers' work on coding, supplier bills and daily bank reconciliations across GBP, USD and EUR accounts

• 
Prepare month-end journals, accruals and prepayments, and the balance sheet reconciliations behind them, so we close by working day 5 with our Finance Manager

• 
Keep intercompany balances with our US entity reconciled

• 
Reconcile payroll, PAYE and pension control accounts to Rippling each month

• 
Prepare the UK VAT return in Xero for review

• 
Prepare year-end schedules and answer queries from our external accountants and auditors

Finance admin and communication

• 
Run the invoice inbox, logging, chasing and routing supplier invoices so nothing reaches the ledger without a document

• 
Chase receipts and missing context from colleagues for card spend, and keep receipt compliance high

• 
Maintain supplier records and support onboarding, including verifying bank details before anything is paid

• 
Be the first point of contact for finance questions from the wider team

👀 Who You Are

• 
2 to 4 years in a finance team or accounting practice, with at least one month-end close owned end to end

• 
AAT qualified, or studying towards or part-qualified in ACCA, CIMA or ACA. We'll support your studies

• 
Confident in Xero or similar cloud accounting software, and comfortable with large data sets in Excel or Google Sheets

• 
Experience with multi-currency reconciliations and high transaction volumes

• 
Clear, friendly written communication. You'll chase people across the company and keep it pleasant

• 
Fintech, marketplace or payments experience is a strong plus

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

• 
A fully reconciled balance sheet gives you real satisfaction

• 
You chase people for answers instead of waiting

• 
You see the admin as part of getting the numbers right, not a distraction from it

• 
You're comfortable in a startup where things move fast around you, even if your work is methodical

• 
You want to grow into a management accountant or financial controller role as the team scales

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

• 
You want to work only on the numbers and see chasing colleagues for receipts as beneath the role

You need heavy supervision or detailed instructions for every task

Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

Travel and office budgets for team off-sites or kitting out your home setup

A benefits package we're actively building out, including gym memberships and apps

A culture built on innovation, speed, excellence, ownership and transparency

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.

What you'll be doing

You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We're determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you'll be pivotal in making this reality.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

• Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.

• Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.

• Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.

• Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.

• Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.

• Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.

• Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.

• Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.

• Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.

Our humble expectations

• Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.

• Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.

• Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.

• A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.

• Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.

• Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.

What we offer

• Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.

• Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.

• Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.

• Growth. Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence.

• Great people. Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

• Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.

• Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.

• Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.

• Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.

• Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.

• Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.

• Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

• 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.

• 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.

• A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.

• Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).

• Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.

• Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

• Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.

• Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.

• Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).

• Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

• A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.

• Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.

• A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.

• Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.

• An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

jobs.title: Data Privacy Analyst - Regulatory Compliance
jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Compliance team’s mission is to keep iwoca a safe and trusted lender for UK small businesses, and to make the compliant path the easy path for the teams we work with.

We make sure iwoca meets its regulatory obligations, particularly the financial crime, sanctions and data protection requirements that apply across our suite of products and services.

We are the second line of defence for the UK business. We advise the people building and running the business on what the rules require, set the policies and standards they work to, and test whether what happens in practice matches them. We work alongside the product teams so that each product meets its obligations and can grow.

Data protection is central to what we do. We hold the data privacy function for the UK business and own how iwoca handles personal data end to end: the lawful basis for how customer, applicant and third-party data is used; data subject access requests and other individual rights; personal data breaches; retention and deletion; records of processing; marketing and consent; the privacy review of new products and features; and the governance of automated decisioning and AI tooling.

How we work:

• 
We enable rather than block. The answer is rarely just “no” — it’s what it would take to get to yes, and what the firm is accepting if it goes ahead anyway.

• 
We go to the source. Positions are grounded in the actual rule, regulation or guidance, and we can show where they come from.

• 
We’re proportionate. Controls match the risk in front of us. We don’t build process for its own sake.

• 
We’re close to the business. We work directly with Tech, Data, Credit, Operations and Legal, and we want to be in the room early rather than at the end.

The role

As Data Privacy Analyst you will run iwoca’s day-to-day UK data protection work and help the business apply UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR in practice. Your primary focus will be the statutory core: data subject access requests, data protection impact assessments, legitimate interests assessments, personal data breaches and records of processing.

The role is not only to run that work but to improve it. A significant part of the job is identifying where our privacy operations could be automated, supported by AI or otherwise improved, assessing what each option would take and what it would mean for compliance, and specifying it well enough for our Tech and Data teams to deliver.

There is real room for the role to grow: as you build credibility, so does the scope, towards owning areas of the framework outright, leading on AI and automation governance, and taking a larger advisory remit across the business.

You will report to the Data Privacy Manager and work closely with the Head of Compliance who also acts as iwoca’s DPO, so you will have experienced support on the harder judgement calls. This is a hands-on role and the work is visible — much of it goes to senior stakeholders or to the regulator.

Impact and influence

• 
Individual rights and data breaches. Own data subject access requests from intake to response — scoping the search, applying exemptions and meeting the statutory deadline — along with erasure, rectification and objection requests. Triage and investigate suspected personal data breaches, assess them against the 72-hour notification test, and keep the breach register accurate.

• 
Privacy assessments and advice. Assist with DPIAs, legitimate interests assessments and other privacy reviews on new products, features, suppliers and data flows. Be an accessible first point of contact for teams across iwoca with a data protection question, and give them an answer they can act on, early enough to shape what they build.

• 
Records, policies and reporting. Keep the record of processing activities accurate as the business changes, hold the retention and deletion schedules to account, review data processing agreements with suppliers, help maintain our data protection policies and standards, and produce the privacy reporting that goes to senior stakeholders.

• 
AI and automated decisioning. Help assess AI tooling and automated decision-making across lending and operations: what personal data goes in, what lawful basis supports it, what the model does with it, and what rights customers have over the outcome. That includes the risks specific to these systems — decisions taken without meaningful human involvement, bias in outcomes, unreliable model output — and recommending how we address them.

• 
Automation and improvement. Identify the manual steps in our privacy operations that should not be manual, assess the options, and set out the requirements and compliance implications clearly enough for Tech and Data to deliver them.

The requirements

Essential skills

• 
Experience. Experience in data protection or privacy operations, or in a compliance, legal, risk or operational role where data protection was a real part of the job.

• 
Data protection knowledge. A solid practical understanding of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR, and of how the ICO expects firms to apply them. Familiarity with the changes made by the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 is an advantage.

• 
Privacy operations and assessments. Hands-on experience of statutory work: DSARs, DPIAs, legitimate interests assessments, breach handling, ROPA maintenance or data processing agreement review. You may not have done all of these — but we want to see that you have done some of them properly.

• 
AI and automation. A real interest in, and working understanding of, how data protection law applies to AI and automated decision-making. Enough technical fluency to see where a manual process could be automated, set out what is needed, and hold your own in a conversation with engineers.

• 
Stakeholder management: Comfortable dealing directly with product, engineering, marketing, credit and operations teams, and able to give a non-specialist a clear answer they can act on rather than a legal summary.

Bonus:

• 
Sector experience. Financial services or fintech, ideally in lending or payments.

• 
Credentials. A privacy or AI qualification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, or ICO-recognised practitioner certificates — or working towards one.

• 
Practical tooling. Experience using Claude Code, LLMs or privacy management platforms.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

• 
Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

• 
Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

• 
Flexible working hours.

• 
Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

• 
A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expense

jobs.description:
About the role 

RELEX’s GTM AI team in Sales builds the AI our sellers use every day. We work across three areas. Salesforce holds the record and runs the sales motion. Claude is a primary surface on which our sellers work, utilising our plugins, skills and connectors. Around Salesforce and Claude sit the other applications sellers use, including applications built on RELEX’s own AI platform, Cortex. This role owns Claude and AI applications outside of Salesforce, and will be responsible for building the AI that RELEX's sellers work with every day. You’ll decide how it’s built and build it yourself as part of a team. 

What you’ll own 

Claude and other AI within the Sales division 

  • Its plugins, skills and connectors, how they’re organised by role, and how they’re released, supported, and retired.
  • What Claude may read and change in Salesforce and related systems, as well as ensuring there are guardrails in place.
  • Human-in-the-loop design: What runs autonomously, what requires human involvement, and designing AI use that sharpens seller judgment rather than flattening it.  
  • Context Portability: What sellers rely on lives in Salesforce and in maintained sources rather than inside an edge system or locally on a machine, so a change of tool doesn’t lead to context loss or significant change effort.
  • How Claude and other AI models can be utilised within Sales and Sales Operations, from Claude Managed Agents and engineering workflows, to utilisation of emerging models (e.g. Jev). 

Applications 

  • Sales’ applications outside Salesforce: Ownership and development of Cortex applications within Sales and self-built systems outside of Cortex, as well as consultation on other 3rd party tools’ AI capabilities and how they contribute to the overall strategy and integrated ecosystem.
  • How our AI connects to the systems around Salesforce, such as enrichment, intent data, engagement, call recording, content, quotes, and signatures.  
  • Sales’ voice with the AI Platform team: what Sales needs from the platform, and how Sales data reaches it with adequate security and user permissions. 

Quality, safety, and value 

  • Ensuring RELEX’s AI data-handling policy is applied in your areas: what each AI may see, and under whose permissions.
  • How prompts and models are tested before release.

Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !

HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-ups françaises les plus prometteuses !

Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.

Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !

Cela implique la gestion directe du budget coût des marchandises et la responsabilité de son impact sur le compte de résultat.   • Construire une vision claire et ambitieuse de ce que doit devenir notre produit physique — ancrée dans la connaissance client, rigoureuse sur le plan commercial, et suffisamment différenciante pour gagner. Développer un point de vue propre et indépendant, nourri des insights de l'équipe Produit globale, mais enraciné dans la réalité du marché français.
  • Garantir l'accès aux informations, analyses et données nécessaires pour prendre des décisions éclairées en matière de développement produit, et traduire la vision en actions concrètes.
  • Pousser l'équipe et l'entreprise à aller au-delà de la feuille de route actuelle — en remettant en question les hypothèses, en interrogeant les arbitrages, et en s'assurant que nous travaillons toujours sur ce qui a le plus d'impact.
  1. Piloter la rétention client et la performance commerciale
  • Faire de la rétention client votre boussole. Construire une vision rigoureuse et fondée sur les données de ce qui la détermine, et mobiliser l'équipe autour des actions qui font vraiment la différence.
  • Prendre des décisions produit en ayant pleinement conscience de leurs implications financières. Prendre des risques calculés, mesurer les résultats honnêtement, et ajuster rapidement quand un pari ne fonctionne pas.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Opérations (Achats, Qualité, Production, etc.) pour assurer une approche coordonnée des initiatives produit, à l'échelle locale comme globale.
  1. Aligner produit et stratégie marketing
  • Travailler main dans la main avec l'équipe brand & marketing pour que la feuille de route produit et la stratégie marketing soient pleinement synchronisées — ce que nous construisons, comment nous en parlons et comment nous le vendons doivent former une proposition cohérente.
  • Être la voix du produit au sein du comité de direction, en portant une vision convaincante de là où le produit doit aller et pourquoi.

  • Fédérateur(rice) transversal(e). Vous installez rapidement la confiance, faites avancer les choses par l'influence, et savez inscrire les bonnes priorités dans les agendas des autres équipes.
  • Bon(ne) résolveur(se) de problèmes — à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté, déterminé(e) à trouver des solutions, avec un réflexe naturel pour l'action.

  • Organisé(e) et structuré(e), avec de solides compétences en gestion de projet et la capacité à tenir des délais serrés.
  • Passionné(e) de food, avec la capacité à transformer les tendances et les signaux marché en offres produit attractives.

As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.
